jobs.title: Senior Project Manager I, IPCM
jobs.description:
Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

Senior Project Manager I, IPCM (Remote)

Full time, United Kingdom, Spain, Poland

If you live in the Warsaw area, this will be a hybrid role working in-office 50% monthly. If you live in the Kraków and Rzeszów areas, this will be a hybrid role working in-office at least one day per week.

The CSS IPCM Senior Project Manager is responsible for delivering different types of projects or programs involving (but not limited to) customer implementations and changes as well as agency projects, internal product implementations, and core business process changes.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for delivering projects or programs with a medium to high complexity, which is measured by the scale and scope of the request. Complexity can be the number of countries or the complexity of the customer or product. Complexity is determined by the IPCM Management team when assigning the request based on the information gathered from the vetting.

As a Senior Project Manager I, IPCM, you will

Plan projects according to the defined scope
Leverage regional and local resources and resources from the different departments and functions to support projects
Be accountable for local, regional, and global project coordination with a broad scope of multi-national countries
Be in control of the utilization of established and proven project management methodology, tools and processes (PMP, OPPM, Prince2, Six Sigma) to scope, plan, analyze, initiate, execute, monitor, and control projects
Facilitate effective and constant communication with all project participants (internal/external)
Facilitate and drive decision-making and escalation concerning the projects assigned

About You

Previous travel industry experience
Prior experience in a qualified project management role and with project management software
Proven success in leading medium-complexity projects in travel management operations
Ability to facilitate and resolve risks, issues, and showstoppers
Advanced knowledge of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Must have good communication skills (written and oral) in English

What We Offer You

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About Us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

https://www.bcdtravel.com/blog/
https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/
https://www.instagram.com/bcdtravel/
https://www.facebook.com/bcdtravel/

You’ll be offered

Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
Travel industry professional perks and discounts
An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

This position is advertised across multiple European locations. The expected annual gross salary ranges by country are as follows:

Spain: 66,000 - 68, 665 EUR
Poland: 150,000 - 165,000 PLN

The final salary offered will ultimately depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and location, and will be determined in line with internal equity.

We do not request salary history and are committed to equal pay in line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com.

Job Description Summary

As related customer equipment, faciliaties or infrastructure projects: responsible for project delivery, profit & loss accountability, and customer satisfaction through management of project related activities and resources. Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline. Functions with some autonomy but guided by established policies or review of end results.

The job allows modification of procedures and practices covering work as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability (quality, volume, timeliness etc.).

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Non-Turnkey Projects or Product/Equipment-Only Projects. Responsible for overseeing the project and direct or indirect leadership and/or management of project resources for small-medium sized projects (size in relation to GE company) that may include equipment-only, suites of products or non-turnkey projects.
Includes direct people management responsibility including staffing and performance development. Utilizes in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline and analytical thinking and technical experience to execute policy/strategy.
Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market
Uses some judgment and has some ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters to address more complicated manufacturing processes with technical variety and/or interdependent production cycles. Uses technical experience and analytical thinking. Uses multiple internal and limited external sources outside of own teams to arrive at decisions.
Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with low risks and resource requirements. Explains information; developing skills to bring team members to consensus around topics within field. Conveys performance expectations and may handle sensitive issues.

Required Qualifications

For roles outside of the USA- This role requires advanced experience in the Project Management & Project Management. Knowledge level is comparable to a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
For roles in USA - Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 6 years of experience in Job Family Group(s)/Function(s)).

Desired Characteristics

Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

Note

To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA.
For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $112,000.00-$168,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:

Bonus Incentives
Paid Certifications
Tuition Reimbursement
Comprehensive Benefits
Career Advancement
This position pays between $69,400 - $119,700/yr based on experience

By embodying our core purpose of customer obsession, new ideas, and driving innovation, and delivering excellence, you will help ensure that every touchpoint is meaningful and contributes to our mission of redefining the possible in healthcare.

The Project Office is critical to support Ensembles growth through flexible but structured Portfolio Project Management (PPM) best practices. The Project Manager of the PMO team will oversee all aspects of assigned projects in one or more areas including technology, operations, clients, HR or process improvements. The responsibilities initially include successfully implementing projects for new and existing clients with a focus on vendor installations on-time, within budget and with the highest quality.

Key activities include establishing a clear charter/scope, project plans with deadlines, assigning responsibilities, monitoring and reporting accurate project health and progress.

Job Responsibilities:

Perform Project Management functions aligned with the PMO best practices for technology, client, vendor, strategic projects and others as needed
Lead project teams through initiation, planning, executing/monitoring and controlling, and closing of designated projects with support from other Project Leaders in the PMO
Ensure project work is well-defined and planned. This includes thorough scope definition, estimation, cost-budgeting, resourcing, scheduling, and placing under ongoing change control
Ensure effective risk, issue, action, and change management, including timely decision making for risks and changes, timely issue resolution, and comprehensive action management
Establish, maintain and execute an effective communications plan serving all stakeholder needs. Ensure team clarity on objectives, scope, and roles, and communicates the work plan with regular and meaningful reports on status and performance
Monitor and manage project performance inclusive of cost and team performance
Manage changes to the project scope, project schedule and project costs using appropriate verification techniques. Measure project performance using appropriate tools and techniques
Adhere to enterprise PMO established best practices and tools for consistency across all projects

Experience We Love:

1 to 3 years' previous experience
1-2 years of Revenue Cycle or healthcare, strongly preferred
Strong communication skills
Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences
This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require

Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience

🌟 Senior Strategic Project Manager | Remote, United States | Pax8

Drive Strategic Transformation at the Centre of Pax8's Growth

Join Pax8 as a Senior Strategic Project Manager and help shape the future of the world's leading AI and cloud marketplace for small and medium-sized businesses. This is an opportunity to lead business-critical initiatives that influence our global strategy, accelerate innovation, and create meaningful impact across the organisation. As Pax8 continues its AI journey, you'll work at the forefront of transformation while growing your own expertise alongside emerging technologies and industry-leading talent.

Why This Role Matters

You'll become part of our world-class Strategy & Operations team, partnering with leaders across the business to bring clarity, structure, and momentum to complex strategic initiatives. This role offers visibility across the organisation and the opportunity to influence how Pax8 scales, evolves, and delivers exceptional outcomes for partners, vendors, and customers.

At Pax8, you'll work in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where ambitious ideas are encouraged and where innovation is embedded into how we operate.

What You'll Be Doing

🔹 Lead high-impact strategic programmes and transformation initiatives from concept through delivery.

🔹 Build and maintain comprehensive project plans that align business priorities, timelines, resources, and outcomes.

🔹 Partner with executive stakeholders to ensure programmes remain focused on delivering measurable business value.

🔹 Create structure and governance frameworks that promote effective decision-making and programme transparency.

🔹 Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and obstacles while proactively driving solutions.

🔹 Coordinate cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and accountability across multiple workstreams.

🔹 Monitor programme performance through metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

🔹 Support organisational change efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes, systems, and ways of working.

🔹 Drive operational excellence by improving workflows, enhancing efficiency, and embedding best practices.

🔹 Ensure quality delivery while balancing stakeholder expectations, strategic priorities, and business objectives.

The Impact You'll Make

Your work will directly influence Pax8's ability to execute strategic priorities, accelerate growth, and deliver transformational outcomes across the business. By bringing clarity to complexity and aligning teams around shared objectives, you'll help strengthen organisational performance and create long-term value for our partners, customers, and employees.

What Success Looks Like

We're Looking For Someone Who Brings

✅ Extensive experience leading complex projects, programmes, or transformation initiatives in fast-paced environments.

✅ Demonstrated consulting, strategy, operations, or business transformation experience.

✅ Strong expertise in programme governance, execution planning, stakeholder engagement, and business operations.

✅ Proven ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.

✅ Strong understanding of project delivery frameworks, including Agile, Scrum, Lean, Kanban, Design Thinking, and Waterfall approaches.

✅ Experience using project management platforms such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Wrike, Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar tools.

✅ Exceptional problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.

✅ Strong financial and budget management capabilities.

✅ Experience leading organisational change and driving successful adoption of new initiatives.

✅ Ability to build trusted relationships, navigate complexity, and deliver results through collaboration.

✅ A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

Trust and Hiring

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.

To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.

We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritising applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.

Inclusion Matters

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.

Benefits

Compensation Range: $95,200 - $136,000 (or more depending on experience)

Competitive Compensation Package Aligned To Experience And Market Benchmarks.

Annual bonus opportunity
Equity participation through stock options
Comprehensive healthcare coverage
Dental and vision insurance
Retirement savings plan with company support

Global collaboration and career growth opportunities
Employee recognition programmes and company celebrations

Grow Your Career with Pax8

There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organisation. You'll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.

About Pax8

Our mission is to build the managed intelligence marketplace and empower small businesses to do more with smarter technology. We are a fast-growing, dynamic, and high-energy organisation with a start-up feel, allowing you to make a meaningful impact on the business. Culture is also important to us, and at Pax8, it's business, and it IS personal. We are passionate, creative, and unconventional. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best! We Elev8 each other. jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help Akamai build a fast, intelligent, and secure network operating on the edge?

Would supporting the biggest global network excite you?

Join our Supply Chain Management Team

We provide support for Akamai's global Infrastructure teams so they can deploy and maintain the networks that power Akamai products and services. Our primary responsibility is management of hardware procurement and distribution. On the Server Procurement team, we focus on planning, buying, and all-inclusive asset management of network servers.

Partner with the best

In this role, you will work closely with external parties such as Server Manufacturers, 3PLs, Carriers, Repair Vendors, as well as with many internal stakeholders on teams in Cloud Technology Group and Finance group.

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

Maintaining the procurement relationship with server vendors, providing feedback for vendor scorecards and participating in quarterly business reviews.
Participating in cross-functional meetings to understand strategies and aligning procurement decisions with short-term and long-term objectives.
Collaborating with Engineering, Design, Program Management, and Planning to integrate new products and technologies while managing roadmap risk and outdated inventory.
Addressing material shortages and unexpected conditions while collaborating with business groups to understand component roles and impacts of delays.
Monitoring pending deployments and suggesting inter-warehouse transfers, project sequencing, and equipment substitutions to optimize timeliness and overall deployment costs.
Demonstrating urgency in researching, tracking, and resolving supply issues efficiently by collaborating with vendors for timely, cost-effective solutions.

Do What You Love

To be successful in this role you will:

Have 5+ years of experience in forecasting/procurement and a Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent.
Have experience utilizing tools like Oracle, Siebel, Tableau, Anaplan, and SQL commonly employed at Akamai for various operational tasks.
Show Project and Vendor Management experience
Demonstrate exceptional analytical abilities in both financial and operational contexts.
Perform detailed tasks independently with precision and accuracy, ensuring exceptional outcomes in all responsibilities undertaken.
Demonstrate exceptional interpersonal, negotiation, and intercultural communication abilities in both written and verbal formats effectively and professionally

About Us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.

Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our Focus Is Simple

Cloud and Edge:
Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

Security
: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.

Content Delivery
: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.

AI
: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai:

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager – Commercial Nuclear Services – Remote. This remote position is based out of our Oak Ridge, TN office.

Your role

Reports to the Senior Director of Commercial Nuclear Services and is responsible for all aspects of the work scope assigned to AtkinsRéalis new and legacy nuclear projects.
The scope may consist of one or more projects.
Requires leadership of all AtkinsRéalis project team members, and responsible for developing work execution plans, assignment of or recruitment of project team members, development of overall work breakdown structure (WBS), project deliverables, organizational chart, budget, schedule, subcontract and supplier strategy, risk management, project forecast and people forecasting and leveling for the project.
Leads by example and set high standards for Health & Safety and Nuclear Safety Culture.
Leads the project organization through day-to-day exhibition of AtkinsRéalis core values: Safety, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, and Excellence.
Assembles a project team through recruiting, interviewing and/or selecting staff with appropriate skills and establishing training and development programs suitable for the work.
This generally requires close coordination with functional managers from various functions (engineering, project controls, safety, quality etc.) and in some cases with Integrated Project Delivery partner companies.
Be accountable for all aspects of one or more projects within the assigned work scope and to lead all team members who are performing duties to ensure that the work progresses with safety, quality, schedule, cost, and contractual requirements.
Develops all project scopes and deliverable definition in compliance with the governing contract documents, quality requirements for the project and any additional customer requirements.
Responsible for all contract management including scope & change control, requirements management, subcontractor and supplier management and governance for any flow-down requirements from the parent contract to subs and vendors.
Responsible and accountable for all aspects of nuclear and industrial safety including adherence to corporate and customer safety programs, development and enforcement of necessary training and requirements, adherence to corrective action programs and enforcement of performance standards for all of the above.
Applies appropriate key performance indicators to monitor project health and performance and establish rigorous reporting protocols that meet all requirements of the contract, corporate standards and project-specific oversight as established by senior management or customer.
Ensures that all project activities are performed in accordance with corporate standards of ethical compliance, cyber-security, import-export regulations, intellectual property protections and security clearance protocols.
Ensures that project procurement and subcontract management including subcontractor and supplier oversight, invoicing, accruals and supply chain strategies are aligned with risk management, quality requirements, schedule and budget considerations and overall performance standards commensurate with the project and customer requirements.
Applies project controls methodology with respect to planning and scheduling, baseline management, cost control, budgeting, cashflow, invoicing, cost and revenue forecasting and resource management.
Develops and implement detailed project execution plans and monitoring their execution through comprehensive reporting to clients and senior management.
Performs rigorous risk analysis in accordance with corporate standards and application of industry best practice including monte-carlo methodology and contingency draw-down curves.
Forms and maintains relationships with clients, partners, suppliers and project stakeholders.
Ensures that all formal approvals for project bids, changes and settlements are prepared and approved in accordance with corporate Level of Authority (LoA) procedures.
Performs other duties as assigned.

About You

Bachelor's degree in Engineering required. MBA Preferred.
Minimum of 15 years commercial nuclear experience.
Minimum of 10 years project management experience.
Minimum of 10 years' experience leading teams.
Experience working in a live Nuclear environment.
Successful management experience. Demonstrated technical and management abilities, including proficient verbal and written communication skills and the ability to scope, task and control the work assigned to a diverse team of personnel supporting project work scope.
Demonstrated ability to independently and critically review work products produced by Engineering teams and provide technical guidance, feedback, mentorship and perform required quality control functions.
Ability to constructively interact with both internal and external customers, including project management staff, clients and other engineering supervisors.
Self-starter who can work in a team environment with minimal direction and supervision. Applies experience and judgment with a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
Broad understanding of the challenges of building and maintaining strong multidiscipline teams and an associated drive to improve both team capabilities and tools to achieve their goals.
Experience in Nuclear Reactor new design and construction projects.
Understanding of large EPC work including subcontracts, prime contract management.
Understanding of nuclear supply chain and materials management principles.
An appreciation of the importance of Quality Assurance Programs and their significance to the nuclear industry.
Excellent organizational, communication and customer relationship skills.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Understanding of project delivery methodology including earned value, critical path scheduling, prime contract and subcontract management, procurement and supply chain methodology and construction work packaging and associated inspection and test plans.
Working knowledge of industrial safety and nuclear safety culture.
Professional Engineering (PE) License.
Project Management experience preferred.
Must be a U.S. citizen in order to be considered.

Rewards & benefits

At AtkinsRéalis, our values—Safety, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, and Excellence—are more than just words. They are the foundation of who we are and how we work. These principles shape our culture, guide our decisions, and inspire us to create an environment where every team member feels empowered to grow, succeed, and make a meaningful impact.

Depending on your employment status, AtkinsRéalis benefits may include medical, dental, vision, company-paid life and short- and long-term disability benefits, employer-matched 401(k) with 100% vesting, employee stock purchase plan, Paid Time Off, leaves of absences options, flexible work options, recognition and employee satisfaction programs, employee assistance program, and voluntary benefits. We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Description

The City of Rochester invites applications for

Senior Project Manager

The City of Rochester is committed to a community where all members feel a sense of belonging. We commit to recognizing the diversity of our community members, listening to ALL
voices and providing equitable services to create an inclusive place to live, play and work.

We believe EQUITY
should be at the center of all our work. We strive to represent our community in our teammates, as we know that diverse and inclusive teams are more innovative, and have an empowering impact on the work, progress and culture of our community.

It takes us all working together

Nature of Work

The Senior Project Manager leads the planning and delivery of large, complex capital improvement projects and enterprise-wide transformational initiatives that advance the City of Rochester’s strategic goals. This position manages projects through the full lifecycle—from concept and scope development through design, construction, implementation, and closeout—ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with City Council direction, organizational priorities, and community needs.

The Senior Project Manager provides advanced project management expertise, oversees consultants and contractors, coordinates work across departments, manages budgets and risk, and communicates complex technical information to diverse audiences. The position also mentors project managers and other junior project team members and contributes to continuous improvement of the City’s project and change management practices.

Work Schedule:
The regular work schedule is Monday through Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm.

Pay
: The 2026 h iring range for this position is $99,419 to $116,964 with advancement to $146,205

Benefits:
This position is eligible for benefits offered by the City of Rochester. Please check out the benefits tab at the top of the page for more details.

To have your application considered in the first round of reviews, please apply before October 18, 2026, at 11:59pm CST.
Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

The City of Rochester will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position including F1 OPT STEM.

Duties And Responsibilities

The work below is representative of the scope of work performed within this job classification.

Lead the delivery of large, complex capital improvement projects from planning through closeout, ensuring high-quality outcomes that create meaningful and lasting community impact.
Manage assigned projects throughout their full life cycle including the planning phase, scope establishment, consultant procurement and contract negotiations, along with leading steps of the various phases of design, right-of-way procurement, permitting, construction bidding, construction administration, project close-out and turnover.
Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, budgets, schedules and stakeholder communications; ensuring technical requirements and contractual/legal obligations are met.
Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams to deliver projects that meet scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance expectations.
Provide technical research and analysis to evaluate, implement, and manage complex project plans and specifications concurrently to meet defined outcomes.
Collaborate with City staff to write and submit grant applications for projects that the City of Rochester pursues.
Coordinate project plans, schedules, and resources to optimize project execution and minimize disruptions to residents, businesses, and City operations.
Monitor projects and produce periodic reports to communicate project status in clear and simple terms to stakeholders.
Manage project expenses to ensure they remain within budget parameters and in compliance with internal procedures and controls.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact project implementation; provide quality reviews, risk analysis, and implement risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate with internal and external partners to address and problem-solve construction-related issues or concerns.
Establish safety goals and plans for each project.
Manage construction work quality and ensure it conforms to current city policies, technical standards, and ordinances.
Serve as an owner's representative during the design and construction phases and manage consultants and contractors retained for project delivery, managing project finances, and the overall project delivery process.
Train and mentor other Project Managers.
Budget and Contract Management
Develop and manage comprehensive project budgets and funding strategies.
Manage project expenditures to ensure compliance with approved budgets, internal controls, and funding requirements.
Prepare contracts for construction of capital projects and negotiate revisions, changes and additions to construction contracts as needed to support successful project delivery.
Advocate and lead negotiations for the City during disputes, disagreements, modifications or change orders related to construction contracts or project changes.
Serve as a City representative for high visibility projects, including multimodal transportation projects, infrastructure projects, and transformational initiatives.
Oversee and serve as the primary contact for work with contractors, developers, consultants, City staff, and their representatives on projects.
Maintain positive working relationships with all stakeholders and foster project buy-in by clearly communicating project goals, benefits, and outcomes.
Implement communication and engagement strategies to ensure community involvement across all sectors of the community, while embracing a Business Forward Strategy that delivers capital projects while focusing on mitigating impacts to local businesses to the maximum extent feasible.
Represent the City at meetings and public forums, presenting complex information to residents, businesses, civic organizations, disadvantaged communities, regulatory agencies, industry groups, private partners, and other stakeholders.
Provide public notifications, updates, and responses to inquiries, complaints, and requests for information related to assigned projects.
Monitor project performance and prepare clear, concise status reports for internal and external stakeholders.
Prepare City Council documentation and present complex technical and financial information to City Council and other governing bodies.
Special Initiatives:
Collaborate with consultants to prepare bid packages that meet City standards and Women/Minority-owned Business Enterprise program goals based on contract values.
Actively work to engage, leverage, and support the City’s Women and Minority Owned Business Program.
Utilize unique and innovative strategies and practices to measure project success through the establishment of data metrics that analyze short- and long-term impacts.
Participate in the department's annual capital and operating budget preparation and monitoring throughout the year which includes personnel, equipment, technology, vehicles, and software costs.
Ensure all assigned projects meet the requirements of the Destination Medical Center District Design Guidelines and other applicable City standards.
Manage consulting contracts for special projects.

Perform Other Duties As Assigned Or Necessary.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Urban Planning/Design, Construction Management, Project Management, Business Administration, Public Administration, or closely related field from an accredited four-year college or university AND a minimum of six (6) years of full-time experience being a key part of a project team that delivers complex civil infrastructure, parks, or urban design type projects

OR

An equivalent combination of education, certification and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may be considered.

Licenses and/or Certifications

Valid driver's license

Desirable Qualifications

A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Urban Planning/Design, Construction Management, Project Management, Urban/Planning, Business Administration, Public Administration, or closely related field from an accredited college or university.

10-years of full-time project management experience involving capital project delivery

Experience managing large multi-discipline projects, construction services, or as an on-site Project Manager.

Project management certification

Professional licensure as a civil engineer, architect, or landscape architect

If this work interests you but you are unsure if you meet all the job requirements listed above, please apply anyway! Your experience is likely more applicable to the role than you think, and the City is interested in candidates who can bring not only technical expertise but a variety of lived experience to the team.

Additional Information

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the following represents the physical and environmental demands for this position. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions with or without accommodation.

In consideration of the overall amount of physical effort required to perform this position, the work is best described as Light Work : Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for Sedentary Work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for Light Work.

Physical demands
that may be required continuously (2/3 or more of the time), frequently (1/3 to 2/3 of the time), and occasionally (up to 1/3 of the time) are noted below:

Frequent demands: sitting, walking, reaching, handling, fine dexterity

Occasional demands: standing, lifting, carrying, pushing/pulling, kneeling

Sensory requirements
necessary in the performance of the essential functions of this position include sight, hearing, touch and smell

Environmental conditions
that may exist in the performance of the essential functions of this job include:

Occasionally working in extreme weather (rain, wind, heat, snow, cold)

Noise (need to shout in order to be heard)

Vibration (exposure to oscillating movements of the extremities or whole body)

Exposure to dust/gas/fumes/steam/chemicals

Work outdoors (no effective protection from weather)

Walk on uneven ground (gravel, rocks, mounds, construction sites)

Work at heights (such as on scaffolding or ladders)

Working around moving machinery (fork-lifts, tractors, mowers)

Protective equipment required (respirator, mask, earplugs, gloves, eyewear, etc.)

Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

The Data Strategy Project Manager is a hands-on, execution-focused professional who blends data strategy analysis with disciplined program management and strategic ownership-building and maintaining roadmaps, owning the development and guidance of strategy for select cross-enterprise data products, and tracking status and financials across EDO initiatives. As the Enterprise Data Office grows quickly and takes on more concurrent workstreams, this role is critical to keeping the portfolio organized, focused, and on track.

Prepare executive-ready communications, dashboards, and briefing materials that translate technical and operational detail into clear narratives.

Own the development and guidance of strategy for select cross-enterprise data products, partnering with domain and product leads to shape direction and priorities.
Support the development of enterprise data strategy deliverables, ensuring project plans and reporting remain grounded in EDO priorities and data standards.

Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. Job Description

This role will be based in Mountain View, CA.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

About the team:

LinkedIn's members entrust us with their information every day and we take their security seriously. Our core value of putting our members first powers all the decisions we make, including how we manage and protect the data of our members and customers. Information Security at LinkedIn is dedicated to protecting and securing business-critical member data and company assets. Our core mission is to empower LinkedIn to create a secure and thriving platform for every member of the global workforce.

We’re hiring a Staff Security Technical Program Manager to drive execution across our Production and Enterprise Security organization. You’ll own critical programs such as vulnerability management, lead cross-functional security initiatives, and establish the operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned on priorities, OKRs, milestones, and outcomes.

You’ll bring structure to complex programs, surface risks and dependencies early, drive decisions to closure, and ensure commitments don’t fall through the cracks. You’ll provide leadership with clear, accurate program status while serving as a force multiplier for engineers by removing blockers and creating clarity without adding unnecessary process.

About the role:

We are seeking a Security Technical Program Manager to join LinkedIn’s centralized TPM Infra organization. In this critical role, you will build and scale a mature production and enterprise security architecture to protect our global platform, members, and organizational assets. You will serve as a key driver across security governance, operational cadences, metrics telemetry, cross-functional program execution, and executive accountability for production and enterprise risk reduction.

Responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end security remediation strategy across the products and infra org by consolidating findings from threat models, code reviews, penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, audits, and postmortems into a unified backlog with clear ownership, prioritization, and defined SLAs.
Establish standardized frameworks for risk identification, tracking, exception management, escalation paths, and remediation validation to ensure operational consistency across security programs.
Define standardized metrics and telemetry dashboards to deliver actionable risk insights for leadership, enabling proactive tracking of systemic vulnerabilities and cross-team remediation accountability.
Establish organizational operating rhythms, including goal setting, dependency mapping, key milestone tracking, and quarterly executive readouts, to maintain continuous visibility into OKR execution across security initiatives.
Manage the vulnerability management lifecycle, including scanning scope, remediation cadences, risk exception workflows, and executive reporting on organizational risk posture.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure third-party security evaluations remain efficient, standardized, and transparent for internal requesters.
Drive complex security programs from initiation to delivery by orchestrating work across Security, IT, Legal, HR, and Compliance partners while ensuring accountability on deliverables.
Establish organizational operating rhythms, including sprint planning, OKR tracking, and backlog governance, to maintain continuous visibility into program execution.
Elevate documentation standards for program specifications, standard operating procedures, architectural decisions, and incident action items to maintain clarity and discoverability.
Establish metrics and key performance indicators to evaluate program effectiveness and convert security telemetry into actionable technical insights.
Lead postmortem reviews and remediation governance for major security incidents, converting key takeaways into resilient architectural controls, automated mechanisms, and updated operating procedures.
Define standardized metrics and telemetry dashboards to deliver actionable risk insights for leadership, enabling proactive tracking of systemic vulnerabilities and cross-team remediation accountability.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in technical program management, including a minimum of 3 years leading complex security initiatives.
Demonstrated track record of orchestrating company-wide vulnerability management lifecycles, driving cross-functional remediation, establishing governance SLAs, and reporting posture metrics to leadership.
Technical expertise to engage effectively with engineering teams, evaluate security risk factors, and navigate fundamental information protection principles across complex domains.
Technical depth to engage effectively with security engineers, assess threat severity, evaluate exploitability, and critically review risk determinations.
Extensive experience managing agile operating rhythms, OKR tracking, task management platforms (such as Jira or Linear), documentation repositories, and executive reporting dashboards.
Exceptional written communication skills with an emphasis on clarity, brevity, and structured documentation.
Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, IT, Legal, HR, and Compliance teams to achieve business alignment and deliver organizational results.
Collaborative mindset with high emotional intelligence and an inclusive approach to problem-solving across diverse organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

BS and 8+ years of relevant work experience
Demonstrated history of partnering with engineering organizations to deliver high-impact, enterprise-scale security initiatives.
Outstanding written and verbal communication capabilities, with a proven track record of adapting complex messaging for diverse technical and executive audiences.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners and engineering leadership to align priorities and advance key security programs.

Suggested Skills

Strategic Portfolio Management
Executive Influence & Stakeholder Leadership
Enterprise Program Delivery
Operating Model & Governance
Executive Communication & Risk Management
Comprehensive understanding of fundamental information security paradigms and security architecture principles

Job Description: Senior Program Manager – Global Information Security
Position Overview
Avancé Consulting Group is seeking an adaptable, high-impact Senior Program Manager to embed directly with Global Information Security (GIS) leadership at a premier global investment management organization.
This role serves as a strategic execution thought partner and delivery lead to a senior pillar head within the Information Security portfolio, bridging high-level security strategies with tactical execution across Global Technology and enterprise business units. Rather than managing a strictly predefined, static scope, you will operate with significant autonomy, partnering 1-on-1 with security domain leaders to unpack complex mandates, establish program structures, prioritize critical initiatives, and drive execution across distributed enterprise teams.
Four positions are currently open across four distinct Information Security functional pillars. Candidates will be aligned to one of these specific domains based on relevant technical background and delivery strengths.
________________________________________
Role Details
• Engagement Type: Contract (12-Month Engagement with high likelihood to extend)
• Target Start Date: October 15, 2026 (Immediate hiring cadence)
• Work Arrangement: Remote (East Coast / Eastern Time alignment preferred; Charlotte, NC hub)
• Operating Model: Embedded within Global Information Security (GIS) leadership under the governance and delivery frameworks of the central Enterprise Change Office (ECO).
________________________________________
Core Responsibilities
• Strategic Thought Partnership: Serve as the dedicated delivery partner to a Security Pillar Lead, translating high-level imperatives, audit remediation goals, and emerging security demands (including AI-driven governance and operational resilience) into structured, actionable program roadmaps.
• Program Delivery & Execution: Establish milestones, drive accountability, track complex cross-functional interdependencies, and manage risks across multi-disciplinary global technology teams without requiring rigid top-down project parameters.
• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Facilitate seamless alignment between Information Security pillar leads, application engineering teams, enterprise architecture, infrastructure operations, and central change management governance.
• Scope Definition & Governance: Dissect broad, ambiguous technical mandates into discrete workstreams, project plans, and measurable operational outcomes.
• Executive Visibility & Reporting: Deliver clear visibility into portfolio delivery status, resource bottlenecks, critical path milestones, and key security deliverables for executive leadership.
________________________________________
Target Pillars & Functional Scope
Candidates will be deployed into one of the following four Information Security pillars:
1. Cybersecurity Incident Management
• Domain Focus: Cyber incident preparedness, response orchestration, crisis escalation paths, and post-incident remediation.
• Core Initiatives:
o Modernize enterprise incident response playbooks and cross-functional crisis communication workflows.
o Mature tabletop exercises and cyber simulation drills across global technology and executive leadership.
o Lead post-mortem tracking, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous control validation workstreams.
• Specialized Acumen: Working familiarity with CSIRT/SOC operating cadences, threat escalation frameworks, and NIST Incident Handling standards (NIST SP 800-61); ability to coordinate cross-functional teams (Legal, Compliance, Communications, SecOps) under time-sensitive conditions.
2. Application Security (AppSec)
• Domain Focus: Embedding proactive security governance directly into the modern software development lifecycle (SDLC) across global engineering teams.
• Core Initiatives:
o Scale developer security enablement, threat modeling workflows, and secure coding standards across product teams.
o Operationalize centralized penetration testing scheduling, vulnerability prioritization, and third-party vendor testing engagements.
o Drive the rollout and engineering adoption of SAST, DAST, SCA, and container security scanning tooling across enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
• Specialized Acumen: Deep familiarity with DevSecOps practices, secure SDLC integration, and application vulnerability remediation cadences across distributed software engineering groups.
3. Identity & Access Security (IAM / Governance)
• Domain Focus: Enterprise identity governance, privileged access management (PAM), and machine/non-human identity controls.
• Core Initiatives:
o Lead program execution around non-human identity lifecycle management (service accounts, API keys, tokens, certificate management).
o Rationalize and execute role-based access control (RBAC) cleanups, least-privilege enforcement, and privileged access workflows.
o Modernize identity governance and administration (IGA) integration across hybrid cloud and enterprise environments.
• Specialized Acumen: Working knowledge of modern IAM architectures (e.g., SailPoint, CyberArk, Okta, Active Directory/Entra ID) and access compliance audits in financial institutions.
4. Security Tooling & Infrastructure Modernization
• Domain Focus: Delivery governance across internal and vendor-provided security tools protecting enterprise infrastructure, endpoints, and cloud environments.
• Core Initiatives:
o Plan and coordinate enterprise-wide security tooling migrations, upgrades, agent rollouts, and rationalizations.
o Track vendor integration milestones, proof-of-concept (POC) evaluations, and enterprise deployment across thousands of endpoints and server instances.
o Partner with enterprise infrastructure and cloud engineering to ensure monitoring coverage and tool telemetry integration with SIEM/data lakes.
• Specialized Acumen: Technical breadth across endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), network security tooling, vulnerability scanners, and telemetry pipelines; strong vendor delivery management.
________________________________________
Qualifications & Key Competencies
• Enterprise Program Management: 7+ years of experience leading complex, large-scale technology programs or portfolios.
• Information Security Acumen: Demonstrated experience supporting cybersecurity, InfoSec, or technology risk domains aligned with at least one of the four core pillars above.

• Financial Services & Investment Management (Nice to Have):

jobs.title: Teamlead Project Manager Product Development
jobs.description:
What is your role?

As Teamlead Project Manager Product Development at Lely, you provide direction to the development of our latest robotics and automation solutions. In this role, you combine leading technically complex development projects with coaching and mentoring a team of project managers. In doing so, you make a direct contribution to both innovative products and the continued professionalization of project management within Lely.

You work according to the New Product Introduction (NPI) process and act as the connecting link between Product Management, Product Development, Integrated Supply Chain, and Field Support. Together with multidisciplinary teams, you translate customer needs into technically feasible and future-proof solutions, while continuously safeguarding quality, planning, and costs.

What makes this role unique is the combination of content-driven leadership and people-focused coaching. You support project managers in their professional growth, encourage knowledge sharing, and actively contribute to shared standards and best practices. You do this in close collaboration with fellow leads and the head of the department.

Your Main Responsibilities Include

Coaching and developing a team of project managers, with a strong focus on collaboration, ownership, and professional growth.
Leading one or more complex development projects within multidisciplinary teams (software, electronics, mechanical engineering, and system integration).
Defining and safeguarding the direction of projects, in line with strategy and NPI processes.
Preparing and monitoring project plans, budgets, risks, and progress.
Ensuring clear communication and effective alignment with internal stakeholders such as product management, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and procurement.
Contributing to the continuous improvement of project management practices within Lely.

Apply now

What is your experience?

You are an engaged and inspiring leader who gains energy from guiding people as well as delivering complex projects. You feel at home in an innovative environment where technical depth and collaboration go hand in hand. You know how to provide direction to teams without losing sight of the human aspect.

In Addition, You Bring

A completed master’s degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or Mechatronics.
At least 7 years of experience as a project manager and/or team lead within a technical development environment.
Proven experience in leading complex product development trajectories (NPI) in a multidisciplinary setting.
A strong technical foundation and the ability to contribute at a system level.
Experience with mechatronics and/or embedded software development is a plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders.
A coaching and results-oriented working style, with a balanced focus on people and performance.

What you can expect from us

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help future-proof the agricultural sector, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international working environment where collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives are valued.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of paid leave per year and a solid pension scheme.
A full-time salary range between €6,500 and €9,300 gross per month, with room for growth within the scale.
Ownership of your personal development, with access to a wide range of courses via the Lely Academy.
Daily access to excellent sports facilities on the Lely Campus, including an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training—and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our in-house barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work–life balance

A healthy work–life balance through our hybrid working policy: you work at least four days per week on Campus, with flexible working hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time on-site (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring a smooth start and end to your workday.
And of course, we love to celebrate! Whether it’s a work anniversary or our Christmas party—at Lely, we know how to celebrate. For an impression, watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

Recruitment & Selection Agencies

We appreciate your interest, but we recruit all candidates directly. While we understand that agencies may wish to introduce candidates to support our ambitions, this is not how our recruitment process is structured. All unsolicited profiles submitted for Lely vacancies will therefore be treated as direct applications.

About Lely

At Lely, we believe in achieving a sustainable, profitable and agreeable future for dairy farmers by combining robotisation, engineering and farming expertise.

It all started with a dream cherished by two brothers in Maassluis 75 years ago, and ever since, we have worked to become innovative market leaders in automated systems for dairy farmers across the globe. With a team of more than 2,800 professional specialists, we work constantly to bring about revolutionary solutions for the agro industry. We are based at our Maassluis Campus, a building which features the highest sustainability performance possible, not just in the Netherlands, but on a global scale. Our overall objective: making dairy farming interesting, also for the coming generations.

Ozan Arikan

Please note that we do not process job applications through WhatsApp due to privacy regulations (GDPR). You can apply via the apply button on this page.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Brokerage
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood's Brokerage TPM team
drives the execution of the most complex, high-stakes engineering programs in the company. We operate at the intersection of product, engineering, design, and operations — providing the structure, clarity, and momentum that large cross-functional programs need to move fast and ship with confidence.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager
, you will own end-to-end execution for one of the highest-profile programs in Robinhood Brokerage right now — a large-scale, cross-functional initiative with real-world impact on how millions of Americans experience financial products. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering teams, product, design, and CX, driving delivery with a high degree of autonomy. You'll also partner closely with the program's operations principal — crafting the narratives and communications that keep internal and external stakeholders aligned. This isn't a role for someone who needs constant direction. This is a role for someone who sees a complex program and knows exactly how to move it forward!

This role is based in our New York City or Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do

Own end-to-end engineering execution for a high-profile, cross-functional Brokerage program — driving delivery across multiple engineering teams with minimal oversight
Serve as the primary coordination layer across product, design, CX, and engineering — filling execution gaps, resolving blockers, and keeping the program moving with clarity and speed
Partner with the program's operations principal to craft concise, polished narratives and stakeholder communications used across internal and external audiences
Identify risks and dependencies early, create structure where it's missing, and hold teams accountable to timelines without slowing them down
Provide engineering teams with the context, clarity, and decision support they need to execute confidently and efficiently
Build and maintain a clear view of program health — surfacing the right information to the right stakeholders at the right time

What You Bring

7+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager, with a track record of independently owning and delivering large-scale, cross-functional engineering programs
Strong technical depth — you understand system design, are comfortable with AWS and core infrastructure concepts, and can hold your own in engineering conversations without needing to write code
Exceptional written communication skills — you write clean, concise narratives and can translate complex technical work into clear stakeholder updates
High agency — you're a self-directed operator who takes a program and runs with it; you don't wait to be managed
Exceptional organizational skills — you thrive in ambiguity, create structure intuitively, and give complex multi-team programs the clarity they need to move
This position requires U.S. citizenship or U.S. permanent resident (green card) status

What We Offer

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Position Restriction:
This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)

$191,000—$225,000 USD

Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)

$168,000—$198,000 USD

Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)

$150,000—$176,000 USD

Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a driven Program Manager to execute the programs that keep Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC) moving. Working within the SCOPE team, you'll own delivery of programs that the Tech-SC depends on.

Own defined programs end-to-end — from intake handoff through delivery
Run repeatable onboarding and product workflows reliably and at pace
Partner across Tech-SC's pillars with high visibility to senior leadership
Grow your scope as you master the mechanics of how Tech-SC delivers

Key job responsibilities

Own the delivery of defined programs from intake handoff through completion — plan, drive, and land against clear goals and timelines
Coordinate cross-functional partners to remove blockers and keep programs on schedule
Identify risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution or clear escalation
Maintain program status, reporting, and stakeholder communication so progress is always visible
Contribute inputs to operational cadences (MBR/QBR inputs, goal tracking) within assigned programs
Support the SCOPE central intake process by taking execution work to delivery

A day in the life

No two programs look the same. One morning you're taking a newly-scoped program and turning it into a plan with a real date on it; by afternoon you're three onboardings deep, keeping each moving while a partner team throws you a curveball you have to clear before it slips. You're the person who makes things land — chasing the dependency nobody else caught, getting the right people in a room, giving leadership a straight answer on where things stand. You'll juggle several programs at once and get sharp at spotting the repetitive work eating everyone's time — and making it disappear.

About The Team

The Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement team is the central program management and business operations function for Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC). We coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage new business intake, and drive delivery assurance across our partner organizations supporting a $1B asset portfolio spanning Amazon Worldwide Stores and AWS infrastructure.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field

jobs.title: Sr Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

What You’ll Do

As Sr. Professional Services Manager
(Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning complex enterprise implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

Responsibilities

Lead complex enterprise implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
Mentor peers by sharing expertise, providing practical guidance, and supporting their growth in implementation leadership, customer engagement, and problem-solving.
Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

How You’ll Work

High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

What Success Looks Like

Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

What You Will Need To Be Successful

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
7+ years leading complex enterprise implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
Formal project or change management certification.

Why First Advantage Is Your Next Big Career Move

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.

Additional Benefits Offered To Our Eligible People Include

Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!
