jobs.title: Teamlead Project Manager Product Development
jobs.description:
Wat is jouw rol?

Als Teamlead Project Manager Product Development bij Lely geef je richting aan de ontwikkeling van onze nieuwste robotica- en automatiseringsoplossingen. In deze rol combineer je het aansturen van technisch complexe ontwikkelprojecten met het coachen en begeleiden van een team van projectmanagers. Daarmee lever je een directe bijdrage aan zowel innovatieve producten als aan de verdere professionalisering van projectmanagement binnen Lely.

Je werkt volgens het New Product Introduction (NPI) proces en bent de verbindende schakel tussen Product Management, Product Development, Integrated Supply Chain en Field Support. Samen met multidisciplinaire teams vertaal je klantbehoeften naar technisch haalbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen, waarbij je continu oog houdt voor kwaliteit, planning en kosten.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van inhoudelijk leiderschap en mensgericht coachen. Je helpt projectmanagers groeien in hun vak, stimuleert kennisdeling en draagt actief bij aan gezamenlijke standaarden en best practices. Dit doe je in nauwe samenwerking met andere leads en het afdelingshoofd.

Jouw Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Coachen en ontwikkelen van een team van projectmanagers, met aandacht voor samenwerking, eigenaarschap en professionele groei.
Leidinggeven aan één of meerdere complexe ontwikkelprojecten binnen multidisciplinaire teams (software, elektronica, werktuigbouwkunde en systeemintegratie).
Bepalen en bewaken van de koers binnen projecten, in lijn met strategie en NPI-processen.
Opstellen en monitoren van projectplannen, budgetten, risico’s en voortgang.
Zorgen voor heldere communicatie en effectieve afstemming met interne stakeholders zoals productmanagement, productie, supply chain, service en inkoop.
Bijdragen aan de verdere verbetering van projectmanagement werkwijzen binnen Lely.

Solliciteer

Wat is jouw ervaring?

Je bent een betrokken en inspirerende leider die energie haalt uit het begeleiden van mensen én het realiseren van complexe projecten. Je voelt je thuis in een innovatieve omgeving waarin technische diepgang en samenwerking hand in hand gaan. Je weet teams richting te geven, zonder het menselijke aspect uit het oog te verliezen.

Daarnaast Breng Je Het Volgende Mee

Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals werktuigbouwkunde, software engineering of mechatronica.
Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als projectmanager en/of teamleider binnen een technische ontwikkelomgeving.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe productontwikkelingstrajecten (NPI) in een multidisciplinaire context.
Een stevige technische basis en het vermogen om op systeemniveau mee te denken en bij te dragen.
Ervaring met mechatronica en/of embedded softwareontwikkeling is een pré.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief te schakelen tussen verschillende belanghebbenden.
Een coachende en resultaatgerichte werkstijl, met gevoel voor balans tussen aandacht voor mensen en het behalen van doelen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector. Wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

Een internationale werkomgeving waar samenwerking, initiatief en diverse perspectieven worden gewaardeerd
Een cultuur die leren, experimenteren en eigenaarschap van ideeën stimuleert
Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
Een fulltime salarisschaal tussen de €6500 en €9300 bruto per maand, waarin we graag nog ruimte zien om te groeien binnen de schaal.
Regie over je eigen ontwikkeling, met toegang tot een breed aanbod aan cursussen via de Lely Academy
Dagelijkse toegang tot uitstekende sportfaciliteiten op de Lely Campus: een indoor gym, outdoor padelbanen, basketbal- en volleybalvelden, tafeltennis en tafelvoetbal. Je kunt deelnemen aan Hyrox-workouts of je inschrijven voor personal training – en je collega’s uitdagen tijdens een actieve pauze.
Verse koffie en thee van onze eigen barista (met melk van onze eigen boerderij) en een gezond, betaalbaar bedrijfsrestaurant

Werk-privébalans

Een gezonde werk-privébalans dankzij ons hybride werkbeleid: je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week op de Campus, met flexibele werktijden en veel ruimte om extra tijd op locatie door te brengen (tussen 06:00 en 20:00 uur).
Een gratis shuttlebus brengt je van en naar de metro in Maassluis, zodat je werkdag soepel begint en eindigt.
En bovendien: we vieren graag! Of het nu een jubileum is of het kerstfeest, bij Lely weten we hoe we moeten vieren! Voor een sfeerimpressie kun je deze video bekijken: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

Ook zijn we trots dat onze inzet en visie zijn bekroond met het winnen van de Rotterdamse Ondernemersprijs 2025!

Recruitment & selectie bureau, consultancy en/of uitzendbureau?

We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat je als intermediair kandidaten wilt aandragen voor onze mooie functies en wilt bijdragen aan onze ambities, maar dit is niet hoe wij ons recruitmentproces hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagde profielen die voor Lely vacatures worden aangeboden, zullen worden behandeld als directe sollicitaties.

Over Lely

Een duurzame, winstgevende en aangename toekomst voor een melkveehouder door robotisering, engineering en boerenkennis te combineren, daar geloven we in.

Dat begon 75 jaar geleden met een droom van twee broers in Maassluis, sindsdien zijn we innovatieve koploper in geautomatiseerde systemen voor melkveehouders over de hele wereld. Met 2500 gespecialiseerde professionals werken we constant aan nieuwe agrarische revoluties. Dan doen we nog steeds vanuit onze Campus in Maassluis, het gebouw met de hoogst haalbare duurzaamheidsprestaties van Nederland, maar ook wereldwijd. Met als doel, melkveehouden voor een volgende generatie (ook) interessant te maken.

Ozan Arikan

Als je bepaalde informatie niet in deze vacature kunt vinden, kun je via WhatsApp contact met ons opnemen.

Houd er rekening mee dat we vanwege privacywetgeving (AVG) geen sollicitaties via WhatsApp verwerken. Je kunt solliciteren via de solliciteerbutton op deze pagina.

jobs.title: AV Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive, Lyft's wholly-owned fleet management subsidiary, is undergoing a transformational shift from traditional rideshare fleet operations to autonomous vehicle fleet ownership and operations. We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad.

This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. You will maintain the program timeline, coordinate cross-functional workstreams spanning infrastructure, people, fleet operations, treasury, legal, and finance, and help ensure that requirements are tracked, dependencies are surfaced, and deployment milestones are met. You will work closely with workstream leads across Operations, Strategy, Infrastructure, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and People.

If you thrive in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex multi-workstream programs, and have a bias toward action, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution
Maintain the program timeline for Flexdrive AV Operating Readiness, tracking deliverables and dependencies across workstreams: Strategic Planning, Infrastructure, Analytics, People, Fleet Operations, Treasury, Finance, and Legal.
Maintain the program's RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), surfacing cross-functional blockers with clear context for escalation.
Support weekly leadership syncs and monthly deep-dive reviews, including preparation, presentation and follow-through.
Translate upstream decisions (partner agreements, market selections, ) into operational requirements, updating the readiness roadmap accordingly.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Serve as a connection point between workstream leads, helping ensure infrastructure timelines align with hiring plans, capital deployment schedules match construction milestones, and fleet operations readiness tracks to vehicle delivery dates.
Act as the central hub across cross-functional internal teams supporting the program; drive alignment on priorities and decisions, escalate issues with the right context, and be accountable for resolution
Coordinate with People and Operations to help sequence hiring, training, and certification programs ahead of vehicle arrivals.
Work with FP&A and Treasury to track investment spend against the capital deployment schedule and flag variance early.
Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
Build and deliver clear status reporting to program leadership and workstream stakeholders.
Ensure cross-functional stakeholders stay aligned on expectations, deliverables, and timelines throughout the program.
Maintain market readiness scorecards that provide visibility into each market's progress against deployment milestones.
Create and maintain program documentation including decision logs, meeting notes, and workstream status trackers.
Process Support & Operational Excellence
Help design and implement the program management operating model for AV readiness
Identify and build process improvements across workstreams, using data to help optimize timelines and resource allocation.
Build repeatable playbooks for market readiness that scale

Experience

5 years of experience in program management, business operations, or a similar cross-functional role, ideally within high-growth tech, fleet management, logistics, or infrastructure-heavy environments
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate operational detail into clear updates for cross-functional stakeholders
Strong organizational skills, with experience tracking timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple workstreams, and adapting whatever program management tools or frameworks the situation calls for
Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve
Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to organize effective working groups and resolve conflicts around program processes and goals.
Strong analytical mindset with ability to identify risks, quantify trade-offs, and recommend courses of action with imperfect information.
Preferred
Experience preparing materials for and presenting to senior leaders
Experience with infrastructure buildout programs (depot construction, facility standup, real estate development).
Background in capital intensive projects, fleet management, automotive, mobility, or autonomous vehicle operations.
Experience managing programs that span domestic and international markets.
Experience in a subsidiary or business unit operating within a larger corporate parent.

Benefits

Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Subsidized commuter benefits
Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

jobs.description:
Position Overview And Primary Duties And Responsibilities (essential Functions)

Alutiiq Career Ventures, LLC a subsidiary of Alutiiq, LLC has an opportunity for a Project Manager. The Project Manager provides overall program, administrative, and functional management for the CONUS RADOME Replacement and Sustainment Documentation effort, overseeing project schedules, resources, risks, deliverables, subcontractor performance, and coordination with Government and other stakeholders. The position exercises independent judgment in directing and coordinating project activities to ensure contractual requirements are met while providing management oversight of, rather than personally performing, specialized engineering, construction, installation, testing, and disposal activities.

Provide overall program, administrative, and functional management for the CONUS RADOME Replacement and Sustainment Documentation effort, including coordination of personnel, subcontractors, schedules, deliverables, resources, and Government requirements.
Serve as a primary management interface with the Program Manager, Government representatives, project stakeholders, subcontractors, vendors, and other organizations supporting contract performance.
Plan, organize, direct, and monitor project activities to ensure contractual requirements, milestones, deliverables, and Government-established deadlines are satisfied.
Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules and internal milestones; identify schedule dependencies, potential delays, and resource constraints and coordinate corrective management actions as appropriate.
Conduct periodic reviews of project scope, schedule, cost, performance, and contractual requirements and recommend adjustments necessary to maintain successful contract performance.
Identify, assess, track, and manage programmatic risks and issues, including schedule, cost, supply-chain, documentation, permitting, coordination, and performance risks; develop and monitor mitigation and corrective-action plans.
Lead recurring project meetings, briefings, teleconferences, videoconferences, site coordination meetings, and other communications with Government and contractor stakeholders; document decisions, action items, responsibilities, and required follow-up.
Coordinate and monitor the work of technical personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and other subject-matter experts responsible for RADOME removal, manufacture, construction, installation, testing, disposal, and other specialized technical activities. Provide management oversight and coordination of these activities without personally performing skilled trade, construction, engineering, installation, testing, or disposal work.
Coordinate contract deliverables and documentation, including COTS manuals, technical data packages, training materials, spares listings, DMSMS life-cycle management data, quality assessment reports, and other required program documentation, ensuring appropriately qualified personnel complete required technical products.
Coordinate with responsible technical personnel and the Government Technical Order Management Agent (TOMA) regarding identification, development, revision, review, approval, and delivery of affected drawings, Interface Control Drawings (ICDs), maintenance manuals, Technical Orders (TOs), Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals (IETMs), and related technical documentation.
Manage and coordinate development and delivery of required operator and maintenance training materials, media, and system documentation by appropriately qualified personnel.
Oversee administrative and programmatic activities associated with initial spares, warranties, maintenance agreements, software licenses, DMSMS planning, and other sustainment requirements.
Coordinate development of OPIR Site Integration Standard (OSIS) packages, scheduling requests, meetings, stakeholder inputs, action-item resolution, and required Government approvals.
Monitor permitting and approval activities performed in support of the project, including construction permits, FAA notifications, base requirements, and other required approvals, and track such actions through successful closure.
Maintain management oversight of project quality and contract compliance by reviewing deliverables, schedules, status information, and performance results and coordinating resolution of identified deficiencies with personnel responsible for technical execution.
Coordinate project closeout and acceptance activities, including tracking completion of required documentation, training, permits, spares, maintenance agreements, inventory transition, Government acceptance requirements, disposition documentation, and required contractual closeout submissions.
Coordinate and interface with Government organizations, subcontractors, vendors, and other companies supporting the effort; facilitate information exchange, schedules, meetings, NDAs, dependencies, and resolution of cross-organizational issues.
Oversee maintenance of project records and configuration-management documentation, including stakeholder/POC information, change-coordination records, meeting information, ICD continuity-file materials, status reports, and required performance-period summaries.
Ensure project personnel comply with applicable contract requirements, security procedures, base installation requirements, documentation requirements, and established Government and company processes.
Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing project activities, resolving programmatic issues, allocating and coordinating resources, recommending corrective actions, and escalating matters that materially affect cost, schedule, quality, contractual compliance, or customer requirements.
Report project status to the Program Manager, including schedule and milestone performance, deliverable status, cost and resource considerations, risks, issues, Government actions, subcontractor performance, and matters requiring management attention or escalation.

Payrate: $119,000 Annually

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, management, engineering, science, or related field.
15+ years of professional experience, including 10+ years of demonstrated program, project, or operational management experience.
Pursuant to the Government Contract, you must be a U.S. Citizen.
Demonstrated experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, subcontractors, vendors, technical personnel, and Government customers.
Demonstrated experience managing project schedules, deliverables, risks, resources, contractual requirements, and customer communications.
Ability to understand technical and contractual information at the level necessary to manage project performance, coordinate subject-matter experts, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate project status to management and customers.
Experience supporting Federal Government and/or Department of Defense contracts preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Commercialization
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Chomps is America's fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

Traits of a Chompian

If you've been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You're a team player who's self-motivated and action-oriented. You're committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You're a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you'll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You're hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

Accepting applications through 10/4/2026 5pm CST

What You Will Do

We seek a highly strategic, deeply organized Senior Project Manager to lead our complex, cross‑category innovation and commercialization initiatives. The ideal candidate brings advanced project leadership experience who does not only monitor progress and manage timelines, budgets, and risks, but also shaping project strategy, driving cross‑functional alignment, and anticipating challenges before they surface. As a Senior Project Manager, you will oversee and influence multiple high‑impact projects through the Stage‑Gate process, ensuring disciplined execution, stakeholder confidence, and consistent on‑time delivery across a fast‑moving innovation pipeline.

Responsibilities

Strategic Project Leadership

Lead and influence cross‑functional teams through complex, innovation projects, overseeing multiple high‑move initiatives simultaneously while driving alignment, strategic prioritization, and timely decision‑making to ensure disciplined execution.
Build strategic project frameworks, challenge assumptions, and proactively identify risks and bottlenecks before they impact timelines.
Drive accountability across teams and elevate issues to leadership when needed to protect launch timing and quality.

Project Management Responsibilities

Lead and influence high‑level, cross‑functional project meetings, driving clarity on updates, risks, decisions, and timelines while ensuring alignment across diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
Design, refine, and lead the complex project timelines (Monday.com), driving strategic prioritization, anticipating timeline risks, and enabling cross‑functional teams to execute with clarity and precision.
Oversee end‑to‑end project performance, using advanced documentation, risk modeling, and mitigation strategies to anticipate issues before they impact delivery.
Drive accountability at all levels, ensuring cross‑functional partners meet commitments and escalating barriers early to protect launch timing and quality.
Orchestrate cross‑functional collaboration, aligning teams around clear objectives, decision pathways, and commercialization requirements for high moving innovation projects.
Manage project scope, budgets, and resources effectively to ensure successful on- time project delivery
Coach, mentor, and elevate project managers and commercialization team members, strengthening Stage‑Gate discipline, operational rigor, and project management excellence across the organization.

Stage-Gate Process:

Support projects through the stage gate process, assisting in ensuring adherence to defined gates and deliverables at each stage.
Partner with the Innovation Director in preparing for gate reviews, including gathering necessary documentation, helping with presentations, taking detailed notes and supporting the documentation of the approvals.
Collaborate with the Innovation Director to make sure the key stakeholders are aligned and facilitate decision-making at each gate.
Provide training on stage gate and commercialization to new team members
Implement robust post launch evaluations to capture learnings and drive continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Facilitate collaboration across product development, marketing, manufacturing, planning, inventory, fulfillment, BAT, sales, and finance.
Promote clear communication and teamwork to manage interdependencies and address conflicts.
Serve as the senior liaison between project teams and leadership, providing clear, concise updates on risks, opportunities, and strategic decisions.

Resource Management:

Partner with internal and external stakeholders to secure the right resources at the right time for complex innovation projects.
Prioritize work across teams to optimize efficiency and ensure critical path tasks stay on track

Continuous Improvement:

Analyze project data to identify trends, productivity opportunities, and systemic improvements and apply key learnings to drive actionable insights that enhance productivity savings.
Champion a culture of learning, cross training, and process optimization.
Lead initiatives that strengthen commercialization discipline across the organization.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
5-8 years experience as a Project Manager, preferably in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) industry.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross functional projects with high ambiguity and high visibility.
Expert in project management methodologies, risk mitigation, and strategic prioritization.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in using project management software and collaboration tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
Exceptional communicator with strong executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to thrive in a team-oriented environment by building relationships , driving alignment , fostering collaboration and driving results with diverse teams
People manager experience preferred
PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
Project managed in remote environment, preferred

Position
: Senior Project Manager, Commercialization

Reports to
: Director, Commercialization Operations

Location
: Remote

Type
: Full-Time, exempt

Salary Range Opportunity:

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $150,000 + 20% annual bonus

Compensation Philosophy & Total Comp:

Our salary ranges are based on verified market data and our philosophy of paying competitively for our size and industry.
Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
In addition to base salary, full-time team members receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K 6% match, and monthly reimbursements for wellness and home office.

Other Perks:

Ability to make an impact: Join a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial-spirited team at a pivotal point to positively impact the food industry.
Opportunities to grow: Advance within Chomps quickly based on outstanding performance.
Unlimited PTO and 15+ paid holiday days + quarterly mental health days. Hybrid & flexible remote schedule. Chicago office open to those in the area.
Paid maternity and paternity leave.
Bi-annual total team in-person activities.
Company-wide Continual Education budget.
Unlimited snacks: Enough meat sticks that if you wanted to eat your body weight in them you could (no judgment here).

Our Commitment

Chomps is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve our mission of making nutritious food more accessible we greatly benefit from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization. Achieving true diversity and inclusion is the right thing to do and the smart thing for our business.

We're aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria. Do you hesitate to submit an application because you believe you need to check every box? Please apply anyway with a thoughtful cover letter! We would love to hear from you to discuss how you can help us build a great team at Chomps.

You must reside in the United States to be considered for this position. Chomps does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Important Notice:

It has come to our attention that fraudsters have been posing as Chomps employees or recruiters and contacting job-seeking candidates regarding potential job opportunities. These fraudulent messages sometimes include a request for payment and confidential personal information. Please note that the Chomps recruiting process does not include asking candidates for payments or other confidential financial information. If you are applying for a job, you can confirm the legitimacy of a job posting by viewing current open roles: https://chomps.com/pages/chomps-careers. If you have questions please email us at people@chomps.com

NTT DATA Federal Services is seeking a Deputy Program Manager (DPM) to serve as the operational delivery leader and second-in-command for agency's program. The DPM will turn program priorities into day-to-day execution across cybersecurity, network, cloud/platform, service-management, field-engineering, and supporting workstreams while keeping staffing, performance, risks, and customer commitments on track.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Financial Risk Mitigation
jobs.description:
Description

This Sr. Program Manager role will lead a program within Financial Integrity Trust (FIT), a team embedded within the Financial Risk Mitigation (FRM) organization. FIT is focused on financial integrity of engagement between seller and Amazon by ensuring a secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers. It is a critical line of defense, stopping bad actors from profiting while ensuring a frictionless experience for SPs. We track “who” is profiting and “where” Amazon disburses funds, and own “when” disbursements occur. We ensure appropriate controls, verifications, and validations for both charge and disbursement instruments, reducing bad actors’ ability to scale fraud and ensure compliance. We also compute and withhold account-level disbursement reserves, govern payment speed, and recover funds from enforced sellers, preventing unpaid fees and misuse of funds.

Key job responsibilities

Mitigate financial risk and stop bad actors from profiting by building tools and setting policies that control how quickly sellers are paid and disburse. This role will work closely with product, tech, policy, legal, and finance stakeholders and partner teams.
Own and communicate strategic vision, updates, goals, policy changes and roadmap to stakeholders and senior leaders. Routinely author documents: PRFAQ’s, Working Backwards, BRD’s, WBR’s/MBR’s/QBR’s, Program Updates etc.
Deliver results and execute multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously. Make data-driven tradeoffs to maintain strategic deliverables.
Operate with a high degree of independence. This role requires a curious, self-starting, fast learner who thrives in ambiguous, challenging spaces.
Set and achieve challenging goals to solve problems. Drive efficiency improvements by eliminating non-value add processes and introducing automation to maximize impact.
Develop solutions that scale in a resource constrained environment. Proactively launch mechanisms and build processes that address future challenges.
Extensively build trust with cross-organizational stakeholders. Use data to influence without authority and drive consensus at all levels of an organization.
Expertly quantify impact with best-in-class analytics and investigation techniques. Advanced Excel skills are a minimum expectation (Advanced SQL is a plus).

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager

Description

The AEGIS program at Leidos
is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager
who will be responsible for ensuring the successful completion of NASA and Kennedy Space Center project engagements in accordance with the AEGIS Statement of Work, established budgets, customer expectations, and industry best practices.

These engagements typically involve the multi-year delivery of Information Technology (IT) services, including systems integration for imagery, data transport systems and distribution, specialized voice systems, NASA documentation, and configuration management administration.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in project management, interpersonal and team-building skills, and the ability to collaborate on and manage technical or business projects, processes, and deliverables. The candidate will also have the ability to recommend solutions, develop strong customer relationships, and drive a high level of customer satisfaction.

The Senior IT Project Manager
will work collaboratively across project engagements with minimal direct supervision while coordinating effectively with others to successfully execute assigned tasks and project requirements.

Join us at AEGIS—where the sky is NOT the limit!

Primary Responsibilities

Provide management and oversight in support of NASA IT COMM and OCIO projects as assigned by the Director of Mission Communication Services.
Maintain controlled area access training as assigned to facilitate entry to controlled areas, working within elevated (heights) work areas, hazardous and clean room locations.
Develop, implement, maintain, and improve organization and operational system business processes, procedures, and standards that promote cross-element standardization.
Identify project risk and mitigate that risk keeping the project on track.
Interface and collaborate with team members, NASA Government leadership and other support contractor teams in the delivery of services to successfully complete assigned projects in support of NASA and Kennedy Space Center and Launch Operations supporting Exploration Ground Systems for Artemis and commercial space flight customers.
Participate in lifecycle project management including requirements analysis, design, and implementation as well as timely, accurate reporting.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Financial Risk Mitigation
jobs.description:
Description

This Sr. Program Manager role will lead a program within Financial Integrity Trust (FIT), a team embedded within the Financial Risk Mitigation (FRM) organization. FIT is focused on financial integrity of engagement between seller and Amazon by ensuring a secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers. It is a critical line of defense, stopping bad actors from profiting while ensuring a frictionless experience for SPs. We track “who” is profiting and “where” Amazon disburses funds, and own “when” disbursements occur. We ensure appropriate controls, verifications, and validations for both charge and disbursement instruments, reducing bad actors’ ability to scale fraud and ensure compliance. We also compute and withhold account-level disbursement reserves, govern payment speed, and recover funds from enforced sellers, preventing unpaid fees and misuse of funds.

Key job responsibilities

Mitigate financial risk and stop bad actors from profiting by building tools and setting policies that control how quickly sellers are paid and disburse. This role will work closely with product, tech, policy, legal, and finance stakeholders and partner teams.
Own and communicate strategic vision, updates, goals, policy changes and roadmap to stakeholders and senior leaders. Routinely author documents: PRFAQ’s, Working Backwards, BRD’s, WBR’s/MBR’s/QBR’s, Program Updates etc.
Deliver results and execute multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously. Make data-driven tradeoffs to maintain strategic deliverables.
Operate with a high degree of independence. This role requires a curious, self-starting, fast learner who thrives in ambiguous, challenging spaces.
Set and achieve challenging goals to solve problems. Drive efficiency improvements by eliminating non-value add processes and introducing automation to maximize impact.
Develop solutions that scale in a resource constrained environment. Proactively launch mechanisms and build processes that address future challenges.
Extensively build trust with cross-organizational stakeholders. Use data to influence without authority and drive consensus at all levels of an organization.
Expertly quantify impact with best-in-class analytics and investigation techniques. Advanced Excel skills are a minimum expectation (Advanced SQL is a plus).

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

jobs.title: Guest Experience In-Restaurant Recovery Experience Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell was born and raised in California and has been around since 1962. We went from selling everyone’s favorite Crunchy Tacos on the West Coast to a global brand with 7,500+ restaurants, 350 franchise organizations, that serve 42+ million fans each week around the globe. We’re not only the largest Mexican-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we’re also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands.

Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high-quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that haven’t been done before… we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries.

We’re a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we’re at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más.

At Taco Bell, we’re Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.

About The Job

This fun and fast-paced position within the Guest Experience team will own Taco Bell's in-restaurant guest recovery programs and tools. Working closely with Digital, Technology, Restaurant Integrations, and other cross-functional partners, this role will ensure restaurants have the systems, resources, and support they need to confidently recover guest issues while creating exceptional guest experiences every day.

This role will lead the evolution of Taco Bell's in-restaurant recovery ecosystem, driving enhancements to recovery tools, technologies, and restaurant programs that make it easier for teams to deliver meaningful guest recovery. In addition to strengthening recovery capabilities, this role will identify proactive opportunities to improve the in-restaurant guest experience through new initiatives and efforts that help create memorable guest moments before issues occur.

Success in this role requires strong project management skills, creative problem solving, and the ability to influence across multiple teams to bring ideas from concept through execution. The ideal candidate enjoys building relationships, thinking strategically, and finding innovative ways to help restaurants deliver exceptional guest experiences while fostering a culture that values guest feedback and continuous improvement.

This individual must be passionate about the restaurant business and our brand. Taco Bell is seeking someone who enjoys collaborating across teams, challenging the status quo, and helping restaurants create experiences that build guest loyalty.

The Day-to-Day

Lead In-Restaurant Guest Experience/Recovery Programs + Tools – 50%

Lead the management, and evolution of Taco Tabs, including new card concepts, program enhancements, inventory planning, and marketplace expansion to help restaurants create meaningful guest moments, support guest recovery, and strengthen community engagement.
Own Taco Bell's in-restaurant guest recovery tools and programs, ensuring restaurants have the resources, communications, and best practices needed to confidently recover guest issues.
Monitor program performance, gather restaurant feedback, and continuously improve recovery programs to maximize adoption and effectiveness.

Drive Recovery Systems + Cross-Functional Initiatives – 30%

Partner with Digital and Technology teams to define business needs and enhance restaurant systems that support guest recovery and offer redemption
Support cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation, piloting new solutions that strengthen restaurant recovery and proactively improve the guest experience.

Manage Guest Feedback + Actioning Programs – 20%

Own restaurant guest feedback and complaint actioning programs, ensuring restaurants have the insights, tools, and guidance needed to take meaningful action.
Develop initiatives that promote a guest-first mindset, helping restaurants leverage guest feedback to improve operations, reduce complaints, and create better guest experiences.

Is this you?

BA/BS in Business, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or a related field preferred.
5+ years of experience in project management, program management, customer experience, client success, account management, restaurant operations, or a related field.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution.
Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills
Creative thinker with a passion for improving guest experiences
Experience partnering with Digital or Technology teams is preferred
Restaurant, hospitality, or guest experience background is a plus

Work-Hard, Play-Hard

Hybrid work schedule (onsite expectation Tues, Wed, Thurs) and year-round flex day Friday
Onsite childcare through Bright Horizons
Onsite dining center and game room (yes, there is a Taco Bell inside the building)
Onsite dry cleaning, laundry services, and carwash
Onsite gym with fitness classes and personal trainer sessions
Up to 4 weeks of vacation per year plus holidays and time off for volunteering
Generous parental leave for all new parents and adoption assistance program
401(k) with a 6% matching contribution from Yum! Brands with immediate vesting
Comprehensive medical & dental including prescription drug benefits and 100% preventive care

This role sits at the forefront of AI security and governance, helping protect an enterprise environment as the adoption of AI tools, models, and autonomous agents accelerates. You will monitor AI activity across the organisation, investigate suspicious or unauthorised usage, and turn security telemetry into actionable findings. The position combines security operations, threat detection, data protection, identity security, and emerging AI risk management. You will contribute to controls and evidence supporting AI governance initiatives, including ISO 42001 and broader regulatory readiness. Working closely with security, identity, legal, engineering, and automation teams, you will help strengthen safeguards around rapidly evolving AI technologies. This is an opportunity to shape practical AI security processes in a collaborative, globally distributed environment.

Accountabilities

Monitor enterprise AI usage across CASB, SWG, OAuth, endpoint, DLP, and other security telemetry to identify unauthorised AI applications, browser extensions, and API-based agents.
Classify AI security findings according to risk and escalate unauthorised or potentially harmful deployments for investigation and containment.
Investigate alerts involving autonomous agents and AI-powered workflows, including anomalous tool chains, unexpected data access, credential misuse, and emerging agent-based attack patterns.
Document investigation findings and coordinate remediation with automation, identity, security operations, and engineering teams.
Monitor AI usage and DLP logs for potential sensitive-data exfiltration through prompts, uploads, plugins, connectors, and other AI interfaces.
Tune and validate AI-specific DLP and detection controls to ensure they operate effectively and identify relevant security risks.
Monitor developer-facing AI tools for policy compliance, credential exposure, non-human identity risks, and other security concerns.
Partner with engineering teams to establish and maintain appropriate security guardrails for code-assistance and agentic development tools.
Maintain and validate AI activity logging, retention, and audit controls to ensure sufficient visibility and traceability.
Collect, organise, and maintain evidence supporting AI security audits, ISO 42001 certification activities, AI impact assessments, and regulatory readiness initiatives.
Analyse false-positive and false-negative trends and recommend improvements to detection thresholds, rules, and investigation logic.
Identify recurring security patterns and contribute them to automation and security-response playbooks.
Collaborate with Security Operations, Identity, Legal, AI/ML Engineering, and governance stakeholders to align findings with incident response and risk-management processes.
Translate technical security findings into clear, risk-based narratives for governance forums, leadership, and executive reporting.

Requirements

3–5+ years of experience in security analysis, SOC, GRC, or a closely related cybersecurity role.
Working knowledge of SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or Google Chronicle, as well as DLP and CASB technologies.
Understanding of AI and LLM security risks, including prompt injection, AI-enabled data exfiltration, model or agent misuse, and shadow AI.
Familiarity with non-human identity concepts, including service accounts, API keys, OAuth tokens, and their associated security risks.
Understanding of threat detection methodologies and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK; exposure to MITRE ATLAS or the OWASP LLM Top 10 is strongly preferred.
Ability to interpret security logs, API telemetry, and structured or unstructured investigation data.
Basic scripting or query skills in Python, SQL, SPL, KQL, or comparable technologies for security investigations and reporting.
Strong written documentation skills and the ability to communicate complex technical findings through clear, risk-based narratives.
Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Demonstrated, hands-on AI security experience in at least one relevant area, such as AI/LLM risk testing, prompt-injection investigation, AI-specific data-exfiltration analysis, shadow AI discovery, CASB/SWG-based application discovery, non-human identity investigations, or agentic AI/MCP security.
Practical experience should include a specific example of identifying a security issue, investigating its underlying cause, and contributing to an outcome or remediation.
Exposure to agentic AI or MCP-based architectures from either a security or engineering perspective is valuable, including experience with technologies such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP servers.
Hands-on exposure to AI governance frameworks such as ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, or EU AI Act risk classifications is advantageous, particularly through audit evidence collection or control testing.
Experience with security platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, Wiz, Orca Security, Microsoft Purview, Abnormal Security, Bolster AI, or comparable technologies is a plus.
Exposure to ML-based anomaly detection or NLP-driven log analysis is beneficial.
Security certifications such as Security+, CISSP Associate, or relevant AI/ML security credentials are advantageous.
Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Benefits

Remote working opportunity from India.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, governance, and emerging technology.
Exposure to enterprise-scale AI security, threat detection, data protection, and identity-security challenges.
Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams spanning security operations, engineering, identity, legal, automation, and governance.
Opportunities to contribute to AI governance and compliance initiatives, including ISO 42001 and emerging AI regulatory requirements.
Professional growth through hands-on work with evolving AI security technologies, frameworks, and attack patterns.
Inclusive and collaborative working environment.
Equal opportunity employment and reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals, in accordance with applicable requirements.

jobs.title: Finance Program Manager, Humanitarian & Emergency Affairs
jobs.description:
Position Title:
Finance Program Manager, Humanitarian & Emergency Affairs

Department:
Finance

Reports to:
Director, Finance (Canada)

Status:
Full-time, Salaried

Location:
Hybrid – Burlington, ON or Byron Center, MI (2 days in Office)

Salary Level:
$82,206 - $92,481 CAD or $80,649 - $90,730 USD

PURPOSE OF POSITION

The Finance Program Manager provides strategic financial leadership, oversight, and business partnering across World Renew's Humanitarian & Emergency Affairs (HEA) portfolio, with primary responsibility for International Disaster Response (IDR) and additional support to Disaster Response Services (DRS) and Refugee Sponsorship & Resettlement Programs (RSRP).

The position serves as the primary finance focal point for HEA, ensuring sound financial stewardship, donor compliance, internal controls, financial monitoring, risk management, partner capacity strengthening, and effective financial management throughout the project lifecycle.

Working closely with the Director of Finance, the Head of Humanitarian & Emergency Affairs, country offices, implementing partners, and institutional donors, the Finance Program Manager provides strategic financial analysis and guidance that supports informed decision-making, strengthens financial accountability, mitigates risk, and promotes effective stewardship of humanitarian resources.

The position has primary responsibility for financial oversight of World Renew's Canadian Foodgrains Bank (CFGB) portfolio while also supporting institutional grants, humanitarian appeals, consortium awards, emergency response funding, and future donor-funded initiatives across the HEA portfolio.

As the principal financial liaison between the Finance Department and HEA, the position strengthens financial systems, improves internal controls, supports organizational learning, and promotes continuous improvement in humanitarian financial management across World Renew.

We do not discriminate based on disability, culture, ethnicity, or gender, and welcome and encourage people from diverse backgrounds to apply.

Major Duties And Responsibilities

Portfolio Financial Management & Oversight (30%)

Provide strategic financial management and oversight across the Humanitarian & Emergency Affairs portfolio, with primary responsibility for International Disaster Response.
Monitor portfolio financial performance, expenditure trends, forecasts, burn rates, budget utilization, and funding gaps.
Develop and maintain executive financial dashboards that provide timely analysis of portfolio performance, donor balances, appeal funding, foreign exchange exposure, and financial risks.
Prepare monthly portfolio financial reports, analysis, and recommendations for the Head of Humanitarian & Emergency Affairs, including emerging risks and actions to strengthen portfolio performance and financial stewardship.
Support annual budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-term portfolio planning.
Collaborate with finance and program teams to develop, monitor, and analyze cost recovery budgets and strategies across the HEA portfolio, maximizing recovery of direct and indirect costs while ensuring compliance with donor requirements.
Monitor humanitarian appeal funding, restricted and unrestricted balances, and funding utilization.
Coordinate fund transfers across the HEA portfolio with Finance and monitor project cash flow requirements.
Monitor exchange rate fluctuations and assess their impact on project budgets and portfolio performance.

Donor Financial Management & Compliance (15%)

Serve as the primary financial focal point for institutional donor-funded grants across the HEA portfolio.
Lead financial oversight of the Canadian Foodgrains Bank (CFGB) portfolio, including equity allocations, budget monitoring, donor compliance, financial reporting, and financial assurance activities.
Support financial management of consortium awards, humanitarian appeals, emergency response funding, and other institutional grants.
Review budget amendments, reallocations, financial reports, grant modifications, donor financial reviews, and grant closeout activities.
Lead development and review of proposal budgets, cost narratives, and supporting financial documentation for institutional funding opportunities.
Ensure compliance with donor regulations, funding agreements, and World Renew financial policies.
Support implementation of organizational sanctions screening, anti-terrorism measures, and other financial compliance requirements associated with institutional donor funding.
Coordinate responses to donor financial inquiries and financial monitoring requests.
Support post-award financial management throughout the project lifecycle.

Financial Monitoring, Internal Controls & Risk Management (25%)

Conduct targeted remote and in-person financial monitoring reviews, in coordination with country finance teams and implementing partners, to complement routine financial oversight, strengthen internal controls, and support donor compliance.
Perform periodic financial spot-checks of institutional donor-funded projects.
Review partner financial reports, supporting documentation, reconciliations, and financial management systems.
Assess financial risks and recommend practical mitigation measures.
Strengthen internal controls, segregation of duties, and financial assurance processes.
Monitor implementation of corrective action plans arising from financial reviews, audits, or donor monitoring visits.
Support fraud prevention initiatives and promote sound financial governance.
Coordinate and support external project audits and follow-up on audit recommendations.

Capacity Strengthening & Technical Support (15%)

Identify financial management capacity gaps and, as appropriate, develop, implement, and/or support capacity strengthening plans and learning opportunities for country offices and implementing partners
Provide technical guidance on financial management and compliance topics, including budgeting, financial reporting, donor requirements, grant financial management, and risk-informed decision-making.
Provide technical guidance and learning support to finance staff and program teams on donor financial requirements and organizational financial policies.
Promote localization by strengthening partner financial management systems and practices.

Financial Coordination & Organizational Support (10%)

Serve as the principal financial liaison between HEA and the Finance Department.
Support financial reporting processes by preparing and providing financial reports and analysis needed by program and leadership teams for program management, oversight, and decision-making.
Collaborate with program teams and procurement staff to support procurement planning, review procurement-related documentation, and ensure compliance with organizational procurement policies and donor requirements.
Support organizational financial planning and portfolio management discussions.
Collaborate with Grants, Program Management, and MEAL teams to strengthen project performance and financial accountability.
Promote sound stewardship by ensuring financial decisions align with donor expectations, organizational values, and program priorities.
Support cross-functional coordination on financial policies, procedures, templates, and organizational systems when they affect HEA financial management.

Strategic Finance & Continuous Improvement (5%)

Contribute to strategic financial planning across the HEA portfolio.
Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting processes, templates, automation, and operational efficiency across the HEA portfolio.
Support organizational learning and continuous improvement by documenting financial lessons learned and applying best practices to future humanitarian financial management.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None

Qualifications

Personal Attributes

Demonstrates a personal Christian faith and commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Renew.
Supports and contributes to an organizational culture rooted in Christian faith, service, justice, compassion, stewardship, and respect.
Demonstrates integrity, professionalism, sound judgment, and ethical financial stewardship.
Strong collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across departments, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
Demonstrates initiative, flexibility, resilience, and adaptability in a dynamic humanitarian environment.
Strong analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Demonstrates diplomacy, collaboration, and the ability to influence others without direct supervisory authority.

Demonstrates commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Essential Skills

Demonstrated expertise in financial management of institutional donor-funded humanitarian or international development programs.
Strong knowledge of donor financial compliance requirements, including budgeting, financial reporting, cost eligibility, and grant lifecycle management.
Demonstrated financial analysis skills, including forecasting, expenditure monitoring, variance analysis, portfolio financial oversight, and executive dashboard development.
Strong understanding of internal controls, financial risk management, fraud prevention, audit readiness, and financial assurance.
Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple grants, funding streams, and competing priorities.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate financial information to both finance and non-finance audiences.
Demonstrated ability to influence, coordinate, and support cross-functional teams without direct supervisory authority.
Strong relationship-building skills with country offices, implementing partners, donors, and finance teams.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, ERP financial systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and financial reporting tools.
Demonstrated commitment to accountability, stewardship, confidentiality, ethical financial management, and continuous improvement.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, International Development, Public Administration, or a related discipline.

Education And Experience

To perform this position successfully, the individual should have:

Minimum seven (7) years of progressively responsible experience in financial management, grant finance, donor compliance, accounting, or nonprofit financial management.
Demonstrated experience managing institutional donor-funded projects throughout the full grant lifecycle.
Experience supporting humanitarian, disaster response, or international development programming.
Experience managing multi-country grant portfolios.
Experience preparing donor financial reports, coordinating audits, and supporting donor financial monitoring visits.
Experience developing proposal budgets and supporting institutional funding opportunities.
Experience strengthening partner financial management systems and financial capacity.
Professional accounting designation (CPA, CGA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent).
Experience with Canadian Foodgrains Bank (CFGB).
Experience supporting Global Affairs Canada (GAC), U.S. Government (USAID/BHA), UN agencies, or other institutional donor funding.
Experience with Sage Intacct or similar ERP financial systems and financial reporting tools.
Experience supporting procurement, sanctions compliance, and organizational financial assurance processes.
Experience in humanitarian programming and faith-based organizations.
Professional proficiency in French, Spanish, Arabic, or other languages relevant to World Renew's programming is considered an asset.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Transportation Operations Management (TOM) Central Programs org is driving change in the Middle Mile. The TOM PMO & Analytics team is looking for a Data Analyst to work within the Analytic Insights team to help drive data-driven decision-making, measurement, and reporting across TOM operations. In this role, you would be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing dashboards, metrics, and analytical solutions that support operational improvements and stakeholder needs across the organization. The TOM PMO & Analytics team delivers best-in-class centralized management of metrics, reporting, data quality, and analytical insights to drive TOM in-yard operational improvements across the Middle Mile.

Key job responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports using Amazon QuickSight and other BI tools to support TOM operational metrics and leadership reporting
Analyze large-scale transportation operations datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement
Partner with program managers and operational stakeholders to define KPIs, establish measurement frameworks, and ensure consistent metric accountability
Develop and automate data pipelines, ETL processes, and reporting workflows to improve data accuracy and reduce manual effort
Implement and maintain AI-powered tools and automation to streamline data intake triage, stakeholder reporting, and operational analytics
Perform root cause analysis on metric variances and present findings with actionable recommendations to leadership
Ensure data integrity and quality across TOM dashboards by defining and enforcing data standards and validation processes
Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and other leadership mechanisms by preparing data-driven insights and variance callouts
Collaborate cross-functionally with various teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
Create and maintain documentation for data sources, metric definitions, data lineage, and standard operating procedures

About The Team

The TOM Program & Data Analytics team integrates strategic program management with analytics transformation across three pillars: 1. Program Execution — Drives end-to-end ownership of metric improvement, product development, and CPI initiatives from concept to measurable impact. 2. Change Management & Strategic Communication — Governs review, approval, and adoption of changes to standard work, policy, pilots, and proposals while aligning stakeholders through strategic communications. 3. Data & Analytics Insights — Ensures teams operate from accurate, timely metrics to identify gaps, measure progress, and make data-informed decisions. Together, these pillars enable TOM to execute programs, govern change, and run the business with data.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Knowledge of a modern programming language (Ruby, Java, Python, or C#)
Experience using data to drive root cause elimination and process improvement
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Asana Project Management Platform, or proven experience with a similar intake and project management tool
Experience in transportation or supply chain
Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau

The Leidos National Airspace Systems Integration Support (NISC) Program
is looking for a Program Analyst
to support the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Office of Advanced Aviation Technologies (AAT).

In this role, the analyst will bridge the gap between technical data systems and day-to-day business needs. Core duties include leading the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) clearance process, improving data intake forms, managing datasets, and building dashboards / visualizations (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Power Apps, Tableau) to help leadership measure program performance.

Potential for up to 90% telework.

Primary Responsibilities

Maintain a centralized LOB Data Request & Needs Matrix to log intake requests, track analytics deliverables, and map data assets to program goals.

Oversee the design, revision, and standardization of program data intake forms, surveys, and digital submission channels to maximize collection efficiency while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

Advanced proficiency and working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, and PowerApps as well as SQL.
Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust Security clearance.

Advanced knowledge of multiple coding languages.
Prior experience working in federal government contracting. Working knowledge of FAA systems.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Product
jobs.description:
## About the Role

The Product Data Analyst will lead the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data to support product strategy, adoption, and execution for a payment gateway. This role works closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Data Insights to ensure data-driven decisions are made throughout the product lifecycle.

You will build analytical frameworks that provide reliable data and insights to internal product teams, helping them measure performance, identify opportunities, improve product experiences, and make informed business decisions. The role is ideal for a highly motivated, curious, and data-driven professional with strong analytical skills and an interest in product development, financial systems, and data science.

## Key Responsibilities

* Lead the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data to drive payment product strategy, adoption, and execution.
* Create and own data roadmaps that improve product performance transparency for product stakeholders.
* Manage data analytics dashboards, track KPIs, and deliver clear, actionable insights to Product Managers.
* Monitor data accuracy and proactively investigate data issues, anomalies, and inconsistencies.
* Support an ad hoc reporting framework that enables Product Managers to analyze customer and CAM surveys, product usage statistics, market research, and other relevant data.
* Conduct opportunity-sizing analyses and develop forecasting models to support strategic decision-making.
* Present data-driven insights and recommendations to product and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Data Insights to design, build, and document analytics frameworks for product experimentation, A/B testing, and advanced modeling.
* Analyze large transaction datasets to identify trends and opportunities across payment channels and methods, including card, ACH, and P2P.
* Help Product Managers define, track, review, and respond to relevant KPI metrics through monthly, quarterly, and yearly analysis cadences.
* Respond to performance inquiries from partners, Support, Engineering, and Product teams.
* Communicate data breakages, investigate root causes, and help drive resolution.
* Monitor transaction data integrity throughout the data lifecycle and investigate incidents and anomalies.
* Partner with Product Engineering to define what data points should be collected from products and how that data should be captured.
* Partner across value streams to validate the accuracy of financial data.
* Clearly communicate data-driven findings to stakeholders on a monthly, quarterly, and yearly cadence.
* Establish and review quarterly OKRs to measure the effectiveness of growth initiatives.
* Promote data discipline across product teams by encouraging analytical approaches and data-led experimentation.
* Identify inefficient operational processes and automate workflows to reduce manual effort.
* Partner across teams to support accurate financial reporting.
* Facilitate ledger and ACH reconciliation by identifying discrepancies and optimizing settlement processes internally and with partners.
* Stay current with data science practices and contribute to the company’s data analytics community and guild.

## Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or 3+ years of experience in a technical financial services role involving data analysis and interpretation.
* Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail when investigating complex financial systems and identifying issues.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to identify trends, anomalies, opportunities, and business insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong business acumen and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced, agile product environment.
* Proactive approach to issue investigation, problem resolution, and initiative execution.
* Experience documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs) covering data ingestion, processing, reporting, analytical frameworks, and supporting tools.
* Strong conceptual thinking and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Tableau and Power BI.
* Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets.
* Experience building data pipelines and ELT workflows.
* Experience with tools such as Fivetran, BigQuery, dbt, or similar data ingestion, warehouse, and transformation technologies.
* Interest in data science and establishing strong data practices across product teams.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with payment, financial services, fintech, or transaction data.
* Experience analyzing large-scale transaction datasets across payment methods such as card, ACH, and P2P.
* Experience with product analytics, product experimentation, or A/B testing.
* Experience developing forecasting models and opportunity-sizing analyses.
* Experience with financial reporting, ledger reconciliation, ACH reconciliation, or settlement processes.
* Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Data teams.
* Experience developing analytical frameworks and data roadmaps.
* Familiarity with advanced modeling and data science concepts.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate manual operational processes.
* Experience establishing KPI frameworks, OKRs, and recurring business-performance reviews.

## Core Skills

* Product Analytics
* Data Analysis
* Financial Data Analysis
* SQL and Data Analytics
* KPI Development and Reporting
* Business Intelligence
* Tableau
* Power BI
* Excel
* Google Sheets
* BigQuery
* dbt
* Fivetran
* ELT Data Pipelines
* Data Quality and Integrity
* Transaction Analytics
* Forecasting
* A/B Testing
* Product Experimentation
* Financial Reporting
* Reconciliation
* Data Visualization
* Stakeholder Communication

## Compensation & Work Arrangement

* **Salary:** $90,000–$120,000 USD
* **Location:** Norwalk, CT, US
* **Work Arrangement:** Remote

NMI provides payment technology that enables businesses, technology providers, entrepreneurs, and fintech companies to offer flexible payment experiences. Its platform supports payments across different methods and commerce environments, helping partners provide modern payment capabilities.

NMI promotes an inclusive workplace and supports initiatives focused on diversity, equity, inclusion, belonging, employee networks, and open discussion. The company welcomes candidates with diverse career paths and backgrounds.

The company is an Equal Opportunities employer and provides reasonable support throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. Employment offers are subject to satisfactory background and financial checks.

* Competitive compensation
* Flexible PTO policy
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Accidental Death & Dismemberment (ADD) insurance
* Short-term disability insurance
* Long-term disability insurance

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
## About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to help drive better business decisions through thoughtful analysis, clear metric definitions, and strong cross-functional partnership. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to answer high-impact business questions, turn ambiguity into structured analysis, and uncover insights that shape strategy.

This role combines business-impact analytics with hands-on analytical data modeling. You’ll help build and maintain clean, reliable data models and transformations that support scalable reporting, trustworthy metrics, and informed decision-making. You’ll join a small, high-impact data team where ownership is meaningful and your work directly influences company growth.

## Key Responsibilities

* Partner cross-functionally to define KPIs, answer strategic questions, and support business decision-making.
* Build reporting and dashboards that drive action rather than simply monitor performance.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Define, document, and maintain core business metrics to ensure consistency across teams.
* Support and improve dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.
* Build and maintain reliable data transformations that improve data accuracy and consistency.
* Help establish and improve data quality, documentation, and reporting standards.
* Contribute to forecasting, experimentation analysis, and predictive or inference modeling initiatives.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Operations, and GTM teams to define and report on relevant business metrics.
* Help improve the company’s analytical data foundation as the organization grows.

## Required Qualifications

* 2–4 years of professional experience in a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar analytics role.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with a modern cloud data warehouse.
* Experience performing exploratory analysis and translating findings into actionable business insights.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence business stakeholders through data.
* Experience driving measurable business impact through analytics.
* Experience building analytical data models, not only dashboards and ad hoc reports.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex datasets, analysis, and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with willingness to take ownership of projects and work outside your immediate area of expertise.
* Familiarity with data ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with dbt, SQLMesh, Dataform, or similar data transformation tools.
* Familiarity with modern BI tools such as Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with version-controlled analytics workflows.
* Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts, including fact tables, dimension tables, and star schemas.
* Proficiency in SQL is required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or another related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, or other business stakeholders.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building predictive or inference models.
* Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.
* Experience implementing data quality testing and documentation practices.
* Experience working with GTM teams to define and report on GTM metrics.
* Exposure to event-based or product analytics data.
* Experience using AI effectively as part of an analytics workflow.
* Experience with modern analytics tooling and cloud data platforms.
* Experience contributing to forecasting, experimentation, or advanced analytical initiatives.

## Technical Environment

The current analytics environment includes:

* Airbyte
* BigQuery
* SQLMesh
* Looker Studio
* Modern BI and analytics tools
* Version-controlled analytics workflows
* Dimensional data modeling

## What This Role Is Not

* This is not a dashboard-only reporting role.
* This is not a pure data engineering position focused on building production infrastructure.
* This is not a purely reactive analytics role; proactive thinking and ownership are valued.
* This is not an isolated role; collaboration with Product, Engineering, Operations, and other teams is an important part of the position.

## Why This Role Matters

As the company grows, a strong analytics foundation is increasingly important for product decisions, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes. This role helps ensure that business metrics are trustworthy, analytical models are scalable, and decisions are supported by structured and defensible analysis.

## Compensation & Work Arrangement

* **Salary:** $90,000–$120,000 USD
* **Location:** Lexington, KY, US (Remote)
* **Work Arrangement:** Fully remote within the United States
* **Experience Level:** Intermediate
* **Headquarters:** Salt Lake City, Utah
* **Residency Requirement:** Must reside in the United States
* Occasional travel to the headquarters is encouraged to build relationships with the team.

## Benefits

* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Company-covered premiums for employees and dependents when enrolled in the HDHP plan.
* 401(k) plan; currently no employer match.
* Flexible paid time off with approximately four weeks of typical PTO usage, without formal PTO tracking.
* Fully remote work within the United States.
* Opportunity to work with a small, high-impact data team and take meaningful ownership of analytics initiatives.
