new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Storage, AWS Hardware Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Sep 29, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hardware Engineering is a fast growing and leading-edge research and development team that creates enterprise compute and storage server designs for our innovative web service and e-commerce technology systems. Our designs are industry-leading in terms of performance, frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the hundreds of thousands of customers who use utility computing today. We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to define and build the next generation of our cloud systems. Our success depends on our world-class server infrastructure; we’re handling massive scale and rapid integration of emergent technologies.

The ideal TPM candidate will be an experienced program manager who is skilled in managing server and storage hardware product development teams across several geographic regions using a variety of suppliers. The successful candidate will be an innovative self-starter and leader. The candidate will be familiar with the cloud computing industry and AWS offerings and will be passionate about providing the best possible customer experience at the best cost. The candidate will have an obsession with data and precise analysis and will use these as inputs to make decisions.

What you will do: As a TPM on the Storage Hardware Engineering team you will be responsible for leading multiple simultaneous storage product development programs in a highly cross-functional environment which includes internal customers and hardware/software development teams, external vendors and technology partners. You’ll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale storage and server deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience at a world-class cost point. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve your product’s performance, quality and cost. Using data and key metrics, you will also drive and measure process improvements that enhance our operational effectiveness. You will work independently in a dynamic, challenging, and fast-changing organization. We’re changing an industry, and we need individuals who are ready for this challenge and who want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Why it matters: Amazon has thousands of unique services, both big and small that power the Retail website (Amazon.com), Amazon Web Services, Kindle, Amazon Instant Video and more. These services run on hardware around the world. We continually need to deploy newer, innovative, and more efficient and cost effective hardware. Your work will drive efficiency and significant cost savings while improving the performance and reliability of our websites and services. Your work will touch development teams and customers around the world.

Why you will love it: You will have exposure to teams and leaders across the entire company. You will be a part of a leading edge research and development team. You will see many aspects of the Amazon business. You will have a direct impact on our bottom line and the ability to improve things for our developers. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership and responsibility for defining and executing processes that deliver both savings and productivity for Amazon.

Key job responsibilities

You manage large, complex technology initiatives, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating systems that are no longer needed.
You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery).
You understand the architecture of the systems you work with (e.g., workflows, APIs, runtime characteristics, design limitations, and maintenance requirements). You influence team technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions.
You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience prioritizing and delivering projects on time in a fast-moving environment
Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
Experienced in storage server design and managing fleet operations for large infrastructure through dashboards and metrics.
3+ years experience in product development working with third party vendors (CM/OEM/ODM)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. new_jobs.title: Teamlead Project Manager Product Development
new_jobs.description:
What is your role?

As Teamlead Project Manager Product Development at Lely, you provide direction to the development of our latest robotics and automation solutions. In this role, you combine leading technically complex development projects with coaching and mentoring a team of project managers. In doing so, you make a direct contribution to both innovative products and the continued professionalization of project management within Lely.

You work according to the New Product Introduction (NPI) process and act as the connecting link between Product Management, Product Development, Integrated Supply Chain, and Field Support. Together with multidisciplinary teams, you translate customer needs into technically feasible and future-proof solutions, while continuously safeguarding quality, planning, and costs.

What makes this role unique is the combination of content-driven leadership and people-focused coaching. You support project managers in their professional growth, encourage knowledge sharing, and actively contribute to shared standards and best practices. You do this in close collaboration with fellow leads and the head of the department.

Your Main Responsibilities Include

Coaching and developing a team of project managers, with a strong focus on collaboration, ownership, and professional growth.
Leading one or more complex development projects within multidisciplinary teams (software, electronics, mechanical engineering, and system integration).
Defining and safeguarding the direction of projects, in line with strategy and NPI processes.
Preparing and monitoring project plans, budgets, risks, and progress.
Ensuring clear communication and effective alignment with internal stakeholders such as product management, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and procurement.
Contributing to the continuous improvement of project management practices within Lely.

Apply now

What is your experience?

You are an engaged and inspiring leader who gains energy from guiding people as well as delivering complex projects. You feel at home in an innovative environment where technical depth and collaboration go hand in hand. You know how to provide direction to teams without losing sight of the human aspect.

In Addition, You Bring

A completed master’s degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, or Mechatronics.
At least 7 years of experience as a project manager and/or team lead within a technical development environment.
Proven experience in leading complex product development trajectories (NPI) in a multidisciplinary setting.
A strong technical foundation and the ability to contribute at a system level.
Experience with mechatronics and/or embedded software development is a plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders.
A coaching and results-oriented working style, with a balanced focus on people and performance.

What you can expect from us

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help future-proof the agricultural sector, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international working environment where collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives are valued.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of paid leave per year and a solid pension scheme.
A full-time salary range between €6,500 and €9,300 gross per month, with room for growth within the scale.
Ownership of your personal development, with access to a wide range of courses via the Lely Academy.
Daily access to excellent sports facilities on the Lely Campus, including an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training—and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our in-house barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work–life balance

A healthy work–life balance through our hybrid working policy: you work at least four days per week on Campus, with flexible working hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time on-site (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring a smooth start and end to your workday.
And of course, we love to celebrate! Whether it’s a work anniversary or our Christmas party—at Lely, we know how to celebrate. For an impression, watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

Recruitment & Selection Agencies

We appreciate your interest, but we recruit all candidates directly. While we understand that agencies may wish to introduce candidates to support our ambitions, this is not how our recruitment process is structured. All unsolicited profiles submitted for Lely vacancies will therefore be treated as direct applications.

About Lely

At Lely, we believe in achieving a sustainable, profitable and agreeable future for dairy farmers by combining robotisation, engineering and farming expertise.

It all started with a dream cherished by two brothers in Maassluis 75 years ago, and ever since, we have worked to become innovative market leaders in automated systems for dairy farmers across the globe. With a team of more than 2,800 professional specialists, we work constantly to bring about revolutionary solutions for the agro industry. We are based at our Maassluis Campus, a building which features the highest sustainability performance possible, not just in the Netherlands, but on a global scale. Our overall objective: making dairy farming interesting, also for the coming generations.

Ozan Arikan

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Brokerage
new_jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood's Brokerage TPM team
drives the execution of the most complex, high-stakes engineering programs in the company. We operate at the intersection of product, engineering, design, and operations — providing the structure, clarity, and momentum that large cross-functional programs need to move fast and ship with confidence.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager
, you will own end-to-end execution for one of the highest-profile programs in Robinhood Brokerage right now — a large-scale, cross-functional initiative with real-world impact on how millions of Americans experience financial products. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering teams, product, design, and CX, driving delivery with a high degree of autonomy. You'll also partner closely with the program's operations principal — crafting the narratives and communications that keep internal and external stakeholders aligned. This isn't a role for someone who needs constant direction. This is a role for someone who sees a complex program and knows exactly how to move it forward!

This role is based in our New York City or Menlo Park office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do

Own end-to-end engineering execution for a high-profile, cross-functional Brokerage program — driving delivery across multiple engineering teams with minimal oversight
Serve as the primary coordination layer across product, design, CX, and engineering — filling execution gaps, resolving blockers, and keeping the program moving with clarity and speed
Partner with the program's operations principal to craft concise, polished narratives and stakeholder communications used across internal and external audiences
Identify risks and dependencies early, create structure where it's missing, and hold teams accountable to timelines without slowing them down
Provide engineering teams with the context, clarity, and decision support they need to execute confidently and efficiently
Build and maintain a clear view of program health — surfacing the right information to the right stakeholders at the right time

What You Bring

7+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager, with a track record of independently owning and delivering large-scale, cross-functional engineering programs
Strong technical depth — you understand system design, are comfortable with AWS and core infrastructure concepts, and can hold your own in engineering conversations without needing to write code
Exceptional written communication skills — you write clean, concise narratives and can translate complex technical work into clear stakeholder updates
High agency — you're a self-directed operator who takes a program and runs with it; you don't wait to be managed
Exceptional organizational skills — you thrive in ambiguity, create structure intuitively, and give complex multi-team programs the clarity they need to move
This position requires U.S. citizenship or U.S. permanent resident (green card) status

What We Offer

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Position Restriction:
This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Tech Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement
new_jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a driven Program Manager to execute the programs that keep Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC) moving. Working within the SCOPE team, you'll own delivery of programs that the Tech-SC depends on.

Own defined programs end-to-end — from intake handoff through delivery
Run repeatable onboarding and product workflows reliably and at pace
Partner across Tech-SC's pillars with high visibility to senior leadership
Grow your scope as you master the mechanics of how Tech-SC delivers

Key job responsibilities

Own the delivery of defined programs from intake handoff through completion — plan, drive, and land against clear goals and timelines
Coordinate cross-functional partners to remove blockers and keep programs on schedule
Identify risks and dependencies early and drive them to resolution or clear escalation
Maintain program status, reporting, and stakeholder communication so progress is always visible
Contribute inputs to operational cadences (MBR/QBR inputs, goal tracking) within assigned programs
Support the SCOPE central intake process by taking execution work to delivery

A day in the life

No two programs look the same. One morning you're taking a newly-scoped program and turning it into a plan with a real date on it; by afternoon you're three onboardings deep, keeping each moving while a partner team throws you a curveball you have to clear before it slips. You're the person who makes things land — chasing the dependency nobody else caught, getting the right people in a room, giving leadership a straight answer on where things stand. You'll juggle several programs at once and get sharp at spotting the repetitive work eating everyone's time — and making it disappear.

About The Team

The Supply Chain Organization Program Enablement team is the central program management and business operations function for Technology Supply Chain (Tech-SC). We coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage new business intake, and drive delivery assurance across our partner organizations supporting a $1B asset portfolio spanning Amazon Worldwide Stores and AWS infrastructure.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
3+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field

new_jobs.title: Sr Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
new_jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

What You’ll Do

As Sr. Professional Services Manager
(Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning complex enterprise implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

Responsibilities

Lead complex enterprise implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
Mentor peers by sharing expertise, providing practical guidance, and supporting their growth in implementation leadership, customer engagement, and problem-solving.
Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

How You’ll Work

High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

What Success Looks Like

Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

What You Will Need To Be Successful

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
7+ years leading complex enterprise implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
Formal project or change management certification.

Why First Advantage Is Your Next Big Career Move

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.

Additional Benefits Offered To Our Eligible People Include

Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!

You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!

The salary range for this position is approximately $100- 125K USD annually.
This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

new_jobs.title: Teamlead Project Manager Product Development
new_jobs.description:
Wat is jouw rol?

Als Teamlead Project Manager Product Development bij Lely geef je richting aan de ontwikkeling van onze nieuwste robotica- en automatiseringsoplossingen. In deze rol combineer je het aansturen van technisch complexe ontwikkelprojecten met het coachen en begeleiden van een team van projectmanagers. Daarmee lever je een directe bijdrage aan zowel innovatieve producten als aan de verdere professionalisering van projectmanagement binnen Lely.

Je werkt volgens het New Product Introduction (NPI) proces en bent de verbindende schakel tussen Product Management, Product Development, Integrated Supply Chain en Field Support. Samen met multidisciplinaire teams vertaal je klantbehoeften naar technisch haalbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen, waarbij je continu oog houdt voor kwaliteit, planning en kosten.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van inhoudelijk leiderschap en mensgericht coachen. Je helpt projectmanagers groeien in hun vak, stimuleert kennisdeling en draagt actief bij aan gezamenlijke standaarden en best practices. Dit doe je in nauwe samenwerking met andere leads en het afdelingshoofd.

Jouw Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Coachen en ontwikkelen van een team van projectmanagers, met aandacht voor samenwerking, eigenaarschap en professionele groei.
Leidinggeven aan één of meerdere complexe ontwikkelprojecten binnen multidisciplinaire teams (software, elektronica, werktuigbouwkunde en systeemintegratie).
Bepalen en bewaken van de koers binnen projecten, in lijn met strategie en NPI-processen.
Opstellen en monitoren van projectplannen, budgetten, risico’s en voortgang.
Zorgen voor heldere communicatie en effectieve afstemming met interne stakeholders zoals productmanagement, productie, supply chain, service en inkoop.
Bijdragen aan de verdere verbetering van projectmanagement werkwijzen binnen Lely.

Solliciteer

Wat is jouw ervaring?

Je bent een betrokken en inspirerende leider die energie haalt uit het begeleiden van mensen én het realiseren van complexe projecten. Je voelt je thuis in een innovatieve omgeving waarin technische diepgang en samenwerking hand in hand gaan. Je weet teams richting te geven, zonder het menselijke aspect uit het oog te verliezen.

Daarnaast Breng Je Het Volgende Mee

Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals werktuigbouwkunde, software engineering of mechatronica.
Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als projectmanager en/of teamleider binnen een technische ontwikkelomgeving.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe productontwikkelingstrajecten (NPI) in een multidisciplinaire context.
Een stevige technische basis en het vermogen om op systeemniveau mee te denken en bij te dragen.
Ervaring met mechatronica en/of embedded softwareontwikkeling is een pré.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief te schakelen tussen verschillende belanghebbenden.
Een coachende en resultaatgerichte werkstijl, met gevoel voor balans tussen aandacht voor mensen en het behalen van doelen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector. Wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

Een internationale werkomgeving waar samenwerking, initiatief en diverse perspectieven worden gewaardeerd
Een cultuur die leren, experimenteren en eigenaarschap van ideeën stimuleert
Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
Een fulltime salarisschaal tussen de €6500 en €9300 bruto per maand, waarin we graag nog ruimte zien om te groeien binnen de schaal.
Regie over je eigen ontwikkeling, met toegang tot een breed aanbod aan cursussen via de Lely Academy
Dagelijkse toegang tot uitstekende sportfaciliteiten op de Lely Campus: een indoor gym, outdoor padelbanen, basketbal- en volleybalvelden, tafeltennis en tafelvoetbal. Je kunt deelnemen aan Hyrox-workouts of je inschrijven voor personal training – en je collega’s uitdagen tijdens een actieve pauze.
Verse koffie en thee van onze eigen barista (met melk van onze eigen boerderij) en een gezond, betaalbaar bedrijfsrestaurant

Werk-privébalans

Een gezonde werk-privébalans dankzij ons hybride werkbeleid: je werkt minimaal vier dagen per week op de Campus, met flexibele werktijden en veel ruimte om extra tijd op locatie door te brengen (tussen 06:00 en 20:00 uur).
Een gratis shuttlebus brengt je van en naar de metro in Maassluis, zodat je werkdag soepel begint en eindigt.
En bovendien: we vieren graag! Of het nu een jubileum is of het kerstfeest, bij Lely weten we hoe we moeten vieren! Voor een sfeerimpressie kun je deze video bekijken: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

Ook zijn we trots dat onze inzet en visie zijn bekroond met het winnen van de Rotterdamse Ondernemersprijs 2025!

Recruitment & selectie bureau, consultancy en/of uitzendbureau?

We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat je als intermediair kandidaten wilt aandragen voor onze mooie functies en wilt bijdragen aan onze ambities, maar dit is niet hoe wij ons recruitmentproces hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagde profielen die voor Lely vacatures worden aangeboden, zullen worden behandeld als directe sollicitaties.

Over Lely

Een duurzame, winstgevende en aangename toekomst voor een melkveehouder door robotisering, engineering en boerenkennis te combineren, daar geloven we in.

Dat begon 75 jaar geleden met een droom van twee broers in Maassluis, sindsdien zijn we innovatieve koploper in geautomatiseerde systemen voor melkveehouders over de hele wereld. Met 2500 gespecialiseerde professionals werken we constant aan nieuwe agrarische revoluties. Dan doen we nog steeds vanuit onze Campus in Maassluis, het gebouw met de hoogst haalbare duurzaamheidsprestaties van Nederland, maar ook wereldwijd. Met als doel, melkveehouden voor een volgende generatie (ook) interessant te maken.

new_jobs.title: AV Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Flexdrive, Lyft's wholly-owned fleet management subsidiary, is undergoing a transformational shift from traditional rideshare fleet operations to autonomous vehicle fleet ownership and operations. We are seeking an AV Program Manager to help drive the cross-functional operating plan that will prepare Flexdrive to receive, staff, and operate AV fleets at scale domestically and abroad.

This role supports the operational backbone of Flexdrive's AV readiness initiative. You will maintain the program timeline, coordinate cross-functional workstreams spanning infrastructure, people, fleet operations, treasury, legal, and finance, and help ensure that requirements are tracked, dependencies are surfaced, and deployment milestones are met. You will work closely with workstream leads across Operations, Strategy, Infrastructure, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and People.

If you thrive in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex multi-workstream programs, and have a bias toward action, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution
Maintain the program timeline for Flexdrive AV Operating Readiness, tracking deliverables and dependencies across workstreams: Strategic Planning, Infrastructure, Analytics, People, Fleet Operations, Treasury, Finance, and Legal.
Maintain the program's RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), surfacing cross-functional blockers with clear context for escalation.
Support weekly leadership syncs and monthly deep-dive reviews, including preparation, presentation and follow-through.
Translate upstream decisions (partner agreements, market selections, ) into operational requirements, updating the readiness roadmap accordingly.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Serve as a connection point between workstream leads, helping ensure infrastructure timelines align with hiring plans, capital deployment schedules match construction milestones, and fleet operations readiness tracks to vehicle delivery dates.
Act as the central hub across cross-functional internal teams supporting the program; drive alignment on priorities and decisions, escalate issues with the right context, and be accountable for resolution
Coordinate with People and Operations to help sequence hiring, training, and certification programs ahead of vehicle arrivals.
Work with FP&A and Treasury to track investment spend against the capital deployment schedule and flag variance early.
Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
Build and deliver clear status reporting to program leadership and workstream stakeholders.
Ensure cross-functional stakeholders stay aligned on expectations, deliverables, and timelines throughout the program.
Maintain market readiness scorecards that provide visibility into each market's progress against deployment milestones.
Create and maintain program documentation including decision logs, meeting notes, and workstream status trackers.
Process Support & Operational Excellence
Help design and implement the program management operating model for AV readiness
Identify and build process improvements across workstreams, using data to help optimize timelines and resource allocation.
Build repeatable playbooks for market readiness that scale

Experience

5 years of experience in program management, business operations, or a similar cross-functional role, ideally within high-growth tech, fleet management, logistics, or infrastructure-heavy environments
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate operational detail into clear updates for cross-functional stakeholders
Strong organizational skills, with experience tracking timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple workstreams, and adapting whatever program management tools or frameworks the situation calls for
Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve
Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to organize effective working groups and resolve conflicts around program processes and goals.
Strong analytical mindset with ability to identify risks, quantify trade-offs, and recommend courses of action with imperfect information.
Preferred
Experience preparing materials for and presenting to senior leaders
Experience with infrastructure buildout programs (depot construction, facility standup, real estate development).
Background in capital intensive projects, fleet management, automotive, mobility, or autonomous vehicle operations.
Experience managing programs that span domestic and international markets.
Experience in a subsidiary or business unit operating within a larger corporate parent.

Benefits

Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
Subsidized commuter benefits
Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $108,000 - $135,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. new_jobs.description:
Position Overview And Primary Duties And Responsibilities (essential Functions)

Alutiiq Career Ventures, LLC a subsidiary of Alutiiq, LLC has an opportunity for a Project Manager. The Project Manager provides overall program, administrative, and functional management for the CONUS RADOME Replacement and Sustainment Documentation effort, overseeing project schedules, resources, risks, deliverables, subcontractor performance, and coordination with Government and other stakeholders. The position exercises independent judgment in directing and coordinating project activities to ensure contractual requirements are met while providing management oversight of, rather than personally performing, specialized engineering, construction, installation, testing, and disposal activities.

Provide overall program, administrative, and functional management for the CONUS RADOME Replacement and Sustainment Documentation effort, including coordination of personnel, subcontractors, schedules, deliverables, resources, and Government requirements.
Serve as a primary management interface with the Program Manager, Government representatives, project stakeholders, subcontractors, vendors, and other organizations supporting contract performance.
Plan, organize, direct, and monitor project activities to ensure contractual requirements, milestones, deliverables, and Government-established deadlines are satisfied.
Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules and internal milestones; identify schedule dependencies, potential delays, and resource constraints and coordinate corrective management actions as appropriate.
Conduct periodic reviews of project scope, schedule, cost, performance, and contractual requirements and recommend adjustments necessary to maintain successful contract performance.
Identify, assess, track, and manage programmatic risks and issues, including schedule, cost, supply-chain, documentation, permitting, coordination, and performance risks; develop and monitor mitigation and corrective-action plans.
Lead recurring project meetings, briefings, teleconferences, videoconferences, site coordination meetings, and other communications with Government and contractor stakeholders; document decisions, action items, responsibilities, and required follow-up.
Coordinate and monitor the work of technical personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and other subject-matter experts responsible for RADOME removal, manufacture, construction, installation, testing, disposal, and other specialized technical activities. Provide management oversight and coordination of these activities without personally performing skilled trade, construction, engineering, installation, testing, or disposal work.
Coordinate contract deliverables and documentation, including COTS manuals, technical data packages, training materials, spares listings, DMSMS life-cycle management data, quality assessment reports, and other required program documentation, ensuring appropriately qualified personnel complete required technical products.
Coordinate with responsible technical personnel and the Government Technical Order Management Agent (TOMA) regarding identification, development, revision, review, approval, and delivery of affected drawings, Interface Control Drawings (ICDs), maintenance manuals, Technical Orders (TOs), Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals (IETMs), and related technical documentation.
Manage and coordinate development and delivery of required operator and maintenance training materials, media, and system documentation by appropriately qualified personnel.
Oversee administrative and programmatic activities associated with initial spares, warranties, maintenance agreements, software licenses, DMSMS planning, and other sustainment requirements.
Coordinate development of OPIR Site Integration Standard (OSIS) packages, scheduling requests, meetings, stakeholder inputs, action-item resolution, and required Government approvals.
Monitor permitting and approval activities performed in support of the project, including construction permits, FAA notifications, base requirements, and other required approvals, and track such actions through successful closure.
Maintain management oversight of project quality and contract compliance by reviewing deliverables, schedules, status information, and performance results and coordinating resolution of identified deficiencies with personnel responsible for technical execution.
Coordinate project closeout and acceptance activities, including tracking completion of required documentation, training, permits, spares, maintenance agreements, inventory transition, Government acceptance requirements, disposition documentation, and required contractual closeout submissions.
Coordinate and interface with Government organizations, subcontractors, vendors, and other companies supporting the effort; facilitate information exchange, schedules, meetings, NDAs, dependencies, and resolution of cross-organizational issues.
Oversee maintenance of project records and configuration-management documentation, including stakeholder/POC information, change-coordination records, meeting information, ICD continuity-file materials, status reports, and required performance-period summaries.
Ensure project personnel comply with applicable contract requirements, security procedures, base installation requirements, documentation requirements, and established Government and company processes.
Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing project activities, resolving programmatic issues, allocating and coordinating resources, recommending corrective actions, and escalating matters that materially affect cost, schedule, quality, contractual compliance, or customer requirements.
Report project status to the Program Manager, including schedule and milestone performance, deliverable status, cost and resource considerations, risks, issues, Government actions, subcontractor performance, and matters requiring management attention or escalation.

Payrate: $119,000 Annually

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, management, engineering, science, or related field.
15+ years of professional experience, including 10+ years of demonstrated program, project, or operational management experience.
Pursuant to the Government Contract, you must be a U.S. Citizen.
Demonstrated experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, subcontractors, vendors, technical personnel, and Government customers.
Demonstrated experience managing project schedules, deliverables, risks, resources, contractual requirements, and customer communications.
Ability to understand technical and contractual information at the level necessary to manage project performance, coordinate subject-matter experts, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate project status to management and customers.
Experience supporting Federal Government and/or Department of Defense contracts preferred.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Commercialization
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Chomps is America's fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

Traits of a Chompian

If you've been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You're a team player who's self-motivated and action-oriented. You're committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You're a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you'll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You're hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

Accepting applications through 10/4/2026 5pm CST

What You Will Do

We seek a highly strategic, deeply organized Senior Project Manager to lead our complex, cross‑category innovation and commercialization initiatives. The ideal candidate brings advanced project leadership experience who does not only monitor progress and manage timelines, budgets, and risks, but also shaping project strategy, driving cross‑functional alignment, and anticipating challenges before they surface. As a Senior Project Manager, you will oversee and influence multiple high‑impact projects through the Stage‑Gate process, ensuring disciplined execution, stakeholder confidence, and consistent on‑time delivery across a fast‑moving innovation pipeline.

Responsibilities

Strategic Project Leadership

Lead and influence cross‑functional teams through complex, innovation projects, overseeing multiple high‑move initiatives simultaneously while driving alignment, strategic prioritization, and timely decision‑making to ensure disciplined execution.
Build strategic project frameworks, challenge assumptions, and proactively identify risks and bottlenecks before they impact timelines.
Drive accountability across teams and elevate issues to leadership when needed to protect launch timing and quality.

Project Management Responsibilities

Lead and influence high‑level, cross‑functional project meetings, driving clarity on updates, risks, decisions, and timelines while ensuring alignment across diverse teams and senior stakeholders.
Design, refine, and lead the complex project timelines (Monday.com), driving strategic prioritization, anticipating timeline risks, and enabling cross‑functional teams to execute with clarity and precision.
Oversee end‑to‑end project performance, using advanced documentation, risk modeling, and mitigation strategies to anticipate issues before they impact delivery.
Drive accountability at all levels, ensuring cross‑functional partners meet commitments and escalating barriers early to protect launch timing and quality.
Orchestrate cross‑functional collaboration, aligning teams around clear objectives, decision pathways, and commercialization requirements for high moving innovation projects.
Manage project scope, budgets, and resources effectively to ensure successful on- time project delivery
Coach, mentor, and elevate project managers and commercialization team members, strengthening Stage‑Gate discipline, operational rigor, and project management excellence across the organization.

Stage-Gate Process:

Support projects through the stage gate process, assisting in ensuring adherence to defined gates and deliverables at each stage.
Partner with the Innovation Director in preparing for gate reviews, including gathering necessary documentation, helping with presentations, taking detailed notes and supporting the documentation of the approvals.
Collaborate with the Innovation Director to make sure the key stakeholders are aligned and facilitate decision-making at each gate.
Provide training on stage gate and commercialization to new team members
Implement robust post launch evaluations to capture learnings and drive continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Facilitate collaboration across product development, marketing, manufacturing, planning, inventory, fulfillment, BAT, sales, and finance.
Promote clear communication and teamwork to manage interdependencies and address conflicts.
Serve as the senior liaison between project teams and leadership, providing clear, concise updates on risks, opportunities, and strategic decisions.

Resource Management:

Partner with internal and external stakeholders to secure the right resources at the right time for complex innovation projects.
Prioritize work across teams to optimize efficiency and ensure critical path tasks stay on track

Continuous Improvement:

Analyze project data to identify trends, productivity opportunities, and systemic improvements and apply key learnings to drive actionable insights that enhance productivity savings.
Champion a culture of learning, cross training, and process optimization.
Lead initiatives that strengthen commercialization discipline across the organization.

Who You Are

Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
5-8 years experience as a Project Manager, preferably in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) industry.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross functional projects with high ambiguity and high visibility.
Expert in project management methodologies, risk mitigation, and strategic prioritization.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in using project management software and collaboration tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
Exceptional communicator with strong executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to thrive in a team-oriented environment by building relationships , driving alignment , fostering collaboration and driving results with diverse teams
People manager experience preferred
PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
Project managed in remote environment, preferred

Position
: Senior Project Manager, Commercialization

Reports to
: Director, Commercialization Operations

Location
: Remote

Type
: Full-Time, exempt

Salary Range Opportunity:

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $150,000 + 20% annual bonus

Compensation Philosophy & Total Comp:

Our salary ranges are based on verified market data and our philosophy of paying competitively for our size and industry.
Individual pay rate decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
In addition to base salary, full-time team members receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K 6% match, and monthly reimbursements for wellness and home office.

Other Perks:

Ability to make an impact: Join a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial-spirited team at a pivotal point to positively impact the food industry.
Opportunities to grow: Advance within Chomps quickly based on outstanding performance.
Unlimited PTO and 15+ paid holiday days + quarterly mental health days. Hybrid & flexible remote schedule. Chicago office open to those in the area.
Paid maternity and paternity leave.
Bi-annual total team in-person activities.
Company-wide Continual Education budget.
Unlimited snacks: Enough meat sticks that if you wanted to eat your body weight in them you could (no judgment here).

Our Commitment

Chomps is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. To achieve our mission of making nutritious food more accessible we greatly benefit from a range of perspectives, which comes from diversity of all types, at all levels of the organization. Achieving true diversity and inclusion is the right thing to do and the smart thing for our business.

We're aware of the research showing that historically underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't believe that they meet all of the criteria. Do you hesitate to submit an application because you believe you need to check every box? Please apply anyway with a thoughtful cover letter! We would love to hear from you to discuss how you can help us build a great team at Chomps.

You must reside in the United States to be considered for this position. Chomps does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

It has come to our attention that fraudsters have been posing as Chomps employees or recruiters and contacting job-seeking candidates regarding potential job opportunities. These fraudulent messages sometimes include a request for payment and confidential personal information. Please note that the Chomps recruiting process does not include asking candidates for payments or other confidential financial information. new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Financial Risk Mitigation
new_jobs.description:
Description

This Sr. Program Manager role will lead a program within Financial Integrity Trust (FIT), a team embedded within the Financial Risk Mitigation (FRM) organization. FIT is focused on financial integrity of engagement between seller and Amazon by ensuring a secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers. It is a critical line of defense, stopping bad actors from profiting while ensuring a frictionless experience for SPs. We track “who” is profiting and “where” Amazon disburses funds, and own “when” disbursements occur. We ensure appropriate controls, verifications, and validations for both charge and disbursement instruments, reducing bad actors’ ability to scale fraud and ensure compliance. We also compute and withhold account-level disbursement reserves, govern payment speed, and recover funds from enforced sellers, preventing unpaid fees and misuse of funds.

Key job responsibilities

Mitigate financial risk and stop bad actors from profiting by building tools and setting policies that control how quickly sellers are paid and disburse. This role will work closely with product, tech, policy, legal, and finance stakeholders and partner teams.
Own and communicate strategic vision, updates, goals, policy changes and roadmap to stakeholders and senior leaders. Routinely author documents: PRFAQ’s, Working Backwards, BRD’s, WBR’s/MBR’s/QBR’s, Program Updates etc.
Deliver results and execute multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously. Make data-driven tradeoffs to maintain strategic deliverables.
Operate with a high degree of independence. This role requires a curious, self-starting, fast learner who thrives in ambiguous, challenging spaces.
Set and achieve challenging goals to solve problems. Drive efficiency improvements by eliminating non-value add processes and introducing automation to maximize impact.
Develop solutions that scale in a resource constrained environment. Proactively launch mechanisms and build processes that address future challenges.
Extensively build trust with cross-organizational stakeholders. Use data to influence without authority and drive consensus at all levels of an organization.
Expertly quantify impact with best-in-class analytics and investigation techniques. Advanced Excel skills are a minimum expectation (Advanced SQL is a plus).

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Seeking a Program Manager, Platform Strategy & Launch Enablement to coordinate the technology and data initiatives required to support a select portfolio of high-priority commercial product launches.

Instead, the role focuses on bringing together the various technology and data efforts required to support successful brand launches while providing leadership with visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and readiness.
Program Management & Delivery Coordination
Lead program management activities across technology and data initiatives supporting designated launch brands.
Maintain integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and key decisions across participating teams.
Coordinate activities across CRM, data, analytics, reporting, and platform workstreams.
Monitor progress against delivery commitments and proactively identify risks to launch timelines.
Facilitate cross-functional planning, status reviews, and readiness discussions.

Connect initiatives across platforms and teams to identify dependencies, overlaps, gaps, and opportunities for synergy.

Promote reuse, scalability, and consistency across technology and data solutions whenever possible.
Partner with business and technology leaders to support informed investment and prioritization decisions.

Coordinate readiness activities across participating teams.
Maintain visibility into capability readiness, deployment plans, and key launch milestones.
Identify and escalate issues that may impact launch support capabilities.
Help ensure technology and data teams are aligned around launch objectives and critical delivery dates.
Governance & Executive Communications
Prepare executive dashboards, status reports, presentations, and leadership updates.
Consolidate workstream updates into a single integrated view of progress and readiness.
Facilitate governance forums and leadership reviews.
Maintain visibility into risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
Translate complex technical and operational information into concise business-focused communications.

Bachelor's degree required.

Experience coordinating complex technology and data initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.

new_jobs.description:
Description

The AEGIS program at Leidos
is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager
who will be responsible for ensuring the successful completion of NASA and Kennedy Space Center project engagements in accordance with the AEGIS Statement of Work, established budgets, customer expectations, and industry best practices.

These engagements typically involve the multi-year delivery of Information Technology (IT) services, including systems integration for imagery, data transport systems and distribution, specialized voice systems, NASA documentation, and configuration management administration.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in project management, interpersonal and team-building skills, and the ability to collaborate on and manage technical or business projects, processes, and deliverables. The candidate will also have the ability to recommend solutions, develop strong customer relationships, and drive a high level of customer satisfaction.

The Senior IT Project Manager
will work collaboratively across project engagements with minimal direct supervision while coordinating effectively with others to successfully execute assigned tasks and project requirements.

Join us at AEGIS—where the sky is NOT the limit!

Primary Responsibilities

Provide management and oversight in support of NASA IT COMM and OCIO projects as assigned by the Director of Mission Communication Services.
Maintain controlled area access training as assigned to facilitate entry to controlled areas, working within elevated (heights) work areas, hazardous and clean room locations.
Develop, implement, maintain, and improve organization and operational system business processes, procedures, and standards that promote cross-element standardization.
Identify project risk and mitigate that risk keeping the project on track.
Interface and collaborate with team members, NASA Government leadership and other support contractor teams in the delivery of services to successfully complete assigned projects in support of NASA and Kennedy Space Center and Launch Operations supporting Exploration Ground Systems for Artemis and commercial space flight customers.
Participate in lifecycle project management including requirements analysis, design, and implementation as well as timely, accurate reporting.
Coordinate with other contractors and supporting groups at KSC.
Prepare monthly activities report in support of contract deliverables including daily time reporting for AEGIS.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8 years of IT project management experience.
Demonstrated experience with business management processes, documentation, budget planning and reporting, and customer service.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with NASA technical and operational teams to understand procurement requirements and recommend procurement decisions based on those requirements.
Ability to develop deliverables, presentations, project plans, and spreadsheets, with exceptional proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong proficiency in Microsoft Project, including an understanding of Waterfall schedules.
Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with peers, management, operational and technical teams, NASA Government customers, and partner contractors.
Strong facilitation, consensus-building, decision-making, creative problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to conduct meetings, multitask, prioritize work, and manage deliverables in an interrupt-driven environment.
Experience with IT project lifecycle management, including formulation, requirements collection and analysis, design testing, validation, verification, implementation, operational transition, and post-operational management, is a plus.

Clearace Requirements

U.S. Citizenship is required.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications

10–15 years of progressively responsible Information Technology (IT) experience, including costing, planning, and execution.
3+ years of experience managing medium-sized professional IT services engagements, including Federal program management experience.
10+ years of demonstrated experience leading IT configuration, change, process, and documentation management activities.

Indirect reporting relationship with the base leadership team (Lead Pilot, Base Mechanic).

Other

One (1) year management or supervisory experience.
Ability to design, execute and measure an effective business and marketing plan.

Education:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent knowledge and experience preferred.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Basic computer skills

Must be able to pass a drug test and background check in accordance with GMR policies.

Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell was born and raised in California and has been around since 1962. We went from selling everyone’s favorite Crunchy Tacos on the West Coast to a global brand with 7,500+ restaurants, 350 franchise organizations, that serve 42+ million fans each week around the globe. We’re not only the largest Mexican-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we’re also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands.

Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high-quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that haven’t been done before… we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries.

We’re a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we’re at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más.

At Taco Bell, we’re Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.

About The Job

This fun and fast-paced position within the Guest Experience team will own Taco Bell's in-restaurant guest recovery programs and tools. Working closely with Digital, Technology, Restaurant Integrations, and other cross-functional partners, this role will ensure restaurants have the systems, resources, and support they need to confidently recover guest issues while creating exceptional guest experiences every day.

This role will lead the evolution of Taco Bell's in-restaurant recovery ecosystem, driving enhancements to recovery tools, technologies, and restaurant programs that make it easier for teams to deliver meaningful guest recovery. In addition to strengthening recovery capabilities, this role will identify proactive opportunities to improve the in-restaurant guest experience through new initiatives and efforts that help create memorable guest moments before issues occur.

Success in this role requires strong project management skills, creative problem solving, and the ability to influence across multiple teams to bring ideas from concept through execution. The ideal candidate enjoys building relationships, thinking strategically, and finding innovative ways to help restaurants deliver exceptional guest experiences while fostering a culture that values guest feedback and continuous improvement.

This individual must be passionate about the restaurant business and our brand. Taco Bell is seeking someone who enjoys collaborating across teams, challenging the status quo, and helping restaurants create experiences that build guest loyalty.

The Day-to-Day

Lead In-Restaurant Guest Experience/Recovery Programs + Tools – 50%

Lead the management, and evolution of Taco Tabs, including new card concepts, program enhancements, inventory planning, and marketplace expansion to help restaurants create meaningful guest moments, support guest recovery, and strengthen community engagement.
Own Taco Bell's in-restaurant guest recovery tools and programs, ensuring restaurants have the resources, communications, and best practices needed to confidently recover guest issues.
Monitor program performance, gather restaurant feedback, and continuously improve recovery programs to maximize adoption and effectiveness.

Drive Recovery Systems + Cross-Functional Initiatives – 30%

Partner with Digital and Technology teams to define business needs and enhance restaurant systems that support guest recovery and offer redemption
Support cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation, piloting new solutions that strengthen restaurant recovery and proactively improve the guest experience.

Manage Guest Feedback + Actioning Programs – 20%

Own restaurant guest feedback and complaint actioning programs, ensuring restaurants have the insights, tools, and guidance needed to take meaningful action.
Develop initiatives that promote a guest-first mindset, helping restaurants leverage guest feedback to improve operations, reduce complaints, and create better guest experiences.

Is this you?

About Us

Clayco is a full-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power & energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports & entertainment related building projects.

The Role We Want You For

We are seeking a talented and motivated Business Intelligence Analyst to join our dynamic Data Analytics team. As a Business Intelligence Analyst at Clayco, you will play a crucial role in analyzing complex data sets, developing impactful data visualizations, and delivering valuable insights to support strategic decision-making. This position requires a unique combination of BI development skills and data analysis expertise.

The Specifics of the Role

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define data requirements and develop innovative solutions that align with business objectives.
Utilize data visualization best practices to create compelling and intuitive visual representations of data, tailored to various stakeholders and business questions.
Apply strong analytical skills to extract meaningful insights from large datasets, using both quantitative and qualitative analysis techniques.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their needs, define data context, and provide detailed data-driven recommendations.
Develop a deep understanding of our back-end data architecture, including JD Edwards and related data structures, leveraging curated data assets and querying databases to explore and find relevant data for analysis.
Ensure data accuracy and reliability by conducting thorough data validation and contextualization.
Contribute to the design and ongoing development of our BI platforms, ensuring optimal performance, security, and usability.
Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences using professional verbal and written communication skills.
Translate business requirements into detailed technical requirements, creating clear documentation and test plans for technical testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Provide support and backup for analytics engineering and data science functions as needed.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, etc.) or relevant experience
5+ years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Developer, Data Analyst, or related role.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferred), with experience in PowerBI/Qlik/DOMO considered acceptable.
Strong command of SQL, including ability to query ERP schemas directly (experience with JDE F-tables a strong plus); knowledge of Python and/or R is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear and actionable insights.
Excellent analytical skills with a keen attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and business teams.
Proven track record of delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn and grow within the field of business intelligence and data analytics.
